title: Meitantei Conan
synopsis:
Shinichi Kudou, a high school student of astounding talent in detective work, is well known for having solved several challenging cases. One day, when Shinichi spots two suspicious men and decides to follow them, he inadvertently becomes witness to a disturbing illegal activity. Unfortunately, he is caught in the act, so the men dose him with an experimental drug formulated by their criminal organization, leaving him to his death. However, to his own astonishment, Shinichi lives to see another day, but now in the body of a seven-year-old child.

Perfectly preserving his original intelligence, he hides his real identity from everyone, including his childhood friend Ran Mouri and her father, private detective Kogorou Mouri. To this end, he takes on the alias of Conan Edogawa, inspired by the mystery writers Arthur Conan Doyle and Ranpo Edogawa.

Shinichi, as Conan, starts secretly solving the senior Mouri's cases from behind the scenes with his still exceptional sleuthing skills, while covertly investigating the organization responsible for his current state, hoping to reverse the drug's effects someday.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.description: While on a date with Ran, Kudo is attacked by two shady thugs who slip him an experimental drug. The effects of the poison will turn Jimmy’s life upside down!

episodes_data.title: The Kidnapped Debutante
episodes_data.description: Conan sets out to discover the fate of a wealthy businessman’s kidnapped daughter. His new identity is a secret to everyone but his eccentric inventor friend, Dr. Agasa.

episodes_data.title: Beware of Idols
episodes_data.description: Pop diva Yoko Okino is being stalked and she’s come to star-struck Richard Moore’s doorstep for help! Luckily for all involved, Conan is on the job, too.

episodes_data.title: Fish Marks the Spot
episodes_data.description: Treasure hunt! When a mysterious coded map ends up in the hands of Conan and his new friends from school, the Junior Detective League is born!

episodes_data.title: The Time Bomb Express
episodes_data.description: On a cross country train, Conan comes across two sketchy men that might be connected to the night of his big shrink! To make matters worse, the hoods are packing a bomb!

episodes_data.title: Tragic Valentine
episodes_data.description: When Rachel and Serena attend a Valentine’s Day dinner party with some boys, Conan decides to tag along. It’s a good thing, too, because murder is on the menu!

episodes_data.title: The Case of the Mysterious Gifts
episodes_data.description: Dr. Woodman has been receiving children’s toys - and cash - once a month for the last two years, and he has no idea why. Conan and Richard take the case and find some interesting twists along the way.

episodes_data.title: The Art Museum Murder Case
episodes_data.description: The owner of an art museum is killed by what appears to be someone wearing medieval body armor from the 15th century. Can Conan bring the killer to justice?

episodes_data.title: Festival Fiasco
episodes_data.description: An author scripts the perfect murder of his ex-partner, complete with an airtight alibi. Can Conan see through the holes in his plot, or has this writer penned himself a perfect happy ending?

episodes_data.title: Deadly Game
episodes_data.description: A star soccer player’s been thrown off his game. A girl claiming to be Jimmy’s girlfriend has surfaced, asking for help in finding a kidnapped boy. Are the events connected?

episodes_data.title: The Moonlight Sonata Murder Case
episodes_data.description: There is murder abound on Moonlight Island, and with every victim that is found, the haunting sounds of a classical composition are heard. Conan must solve the crime before all the suspects disappear!

episodes_data.title: Kidnapped: Ayumi
episodes_data.description: An innocent game of hide-and-seek becomes a race through the city when two thugs kidnap Amy. With the clock running against them, can the Junior Detective League rescue her before it`s too late?

episodes_data.title: Mystery Mastermind
episodes_data.description: Richard finds the missing father of a girl named Michelle. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and Michelle has vanished. It’s up to Conan to find the girl before it’s too late!

episodes_data.title: The Shooter
episodes_data.description: As Conan’s gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Meguire and Richard of its importance before it’s too late?

episodes_data.title: The Two Faced Brother
episodes_data.description: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

episodes_data.title: A Loan Repaid
episodes_data.description: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword.  Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

episodes_data.title: The Case of the Hi-Jacked Department Store
episodes_data.description: When Conan and his pals find themselves locked in a department store, they stumble right into the hands of a vicious ring of burglars. Will anyone come to their rescue?

episodes_data.title: Wedding Day Blues
episodes_data.description: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride’s favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

episodes_data.title: Fashion Sense
episodes_data.description: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Richard, and Rachel, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

episodes_data.title: The Disappearing Act
episodes_data.description: Conan, George, Mitch, and Amy explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

episodes_data.title: Lights, Camera... Murder
episodes_data.description: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

episodes_data.title: Smooth Sailing: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to relax aboard a cruise ship, but the gang soon ends up being cast into the middle of a dangerous family drama.  Can Conan find the killer before he takes out the entire family?

episodes_data.title: Smooth Sailing: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it’s revealed that Theodore’s escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan’s on the case.

episodes_data.title: Better Off Forgotten
episodes_data.description: During Richard’s day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

episodes_data.title: The Counterfeit Ransom Kidnapping
episodes_data.description: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

episodes_data.title: Jack Attacks!
episodes_data.description: A dog named Jack kills a college student, shocking the dog’s owner and Conan as well! Conan’s known the pooch forever, and if he doesn’t get to the bottom of the attack, Jack will be put to sleep!

episodes_data.title: Kogorou's Class Reunion: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan and Rachel join Richard for the 15-year reunion of Moore’s state-winning Judo team. But when the knock-out Jamie Hummelford turns up dead in her room, reminiscing will have to wait.

episodes_data.title: Kogorou's Class Reunion: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Richard’s class reunion continues, and the killer is still among them. Can Conan apprehend him in time? Everyone’s a suspect in this exciting episode of Case Closed!

episodes_data.title: The Computer Murder
episodes_data.description: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

episodes_data.title: The Missing Melody
episodes_data.description: When an attorney’s wife is murdered under strange circumstances, Conan steps in to make sense of it all.  A music box, a telephone call, and a staple all point to a killer no one would expect.

episodes_data.title: Murder at the Television Studio
episodes_data.description: Richard Moore stars on the popular television show Prime Time Mystery Hour, and while Conan and Rachel enjoy the broadcast from the audience, a vicious murder takes place at the studio.

episodes_data.title: Murder at the Local Diner
episodes_data.description: Rachel has a date and Conan is determined to find out who this guy is. But when a brutal murder takes place at the diner he’s in, Conan steps into his detective shoes to solve the case.

episodes_data.title: A Hunting We Will Go
episodes_data.description: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They’re lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

episodes_data.title: Mountain Villa Murder: Part 1
episodes_data.description: When Rachel is invited to a friend’s villa, it seems like an ideal get-away from the city. But when one of the guests is murdered, the holiday turns into a nightmare - and Rachel’s the killer’s next target!

episodes_data.title: Mountain Villa Murder: Part 2
episodes_data.description: A group of Rachel’s old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

episodes_data.title: Wrong Place at the Wrong Time
episodes_data.description: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan’s investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

episodes_data.title: Prickly Past
episodes_data.description: When a pretty girl hires Detective Moore to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé!

episodes_data.title: Flames of Confusion
episodes_data.description: When a body is discovered in a bonfire, Moore finds out that the victim is the same man he’s been tailing for the past three days! Can Conan crack the case before the prime suspect leaves the country?

episodes_data.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues: Part 1
episodes_data.description: A billionaire hosts a birthday gala for his daughter Reika and Detective Moore is the celebrity guest of honor. But when one of Reika’s suitors turns up dead, the remaining guests are suspects for murder.

episodes_data.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues: Part 2
episodes_data.description: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin’s sinister game.

episodes_data.title: Left in Tatters
episodes_data.description: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

episodes_data.title: Karaoke Killing
episodes_data.description: Rachel and Serena find themselves in a Karaoke Bar with the hottest band in the land! It seems like a dream come true until the brash lead singer - Justin Moon - is poisoned right in front of their eyes.

episodes_data.title: Conan Is Kidnapped
episodes_data.description: A lady who claims to be Conan’s mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

episodes_data.title: Unhappy Birthday
episodes_data.description: Richard, Rachel, and Conan land in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire. Conan must face one disturbing reality: the prime suspects are the victim’s children.

episodes_data.title: Unexpected Visitors
episodes_data.description: Richard stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she was expecting company?

episodes_data.title: A Game of Murder
episodes_data.description: Conan’s ski-trip goes awry when a medical professor is murdered. A secret message left by the victim points to one of his students as being the killer.

episodes_data.title: The Last Dive
episodes_data.description: The rivalry between two divers boils over as the reigning champ is found dead. It looks as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident, but Conan knows that nothing is ever as it seems.

episodes_data.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Harley Hartwell comes looking for Jimmy Kudo to prove which of them is the best detective. But before Conan can save his reputation, a mysterious sickness threatens to close his file for good!

episodes_data.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Jimmy Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Jimmy tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Harley Hartwell heats up!

episodes_data.title: The Book Without Pages
episodes_data.description: An afternoon at the library turns into the hunt for a corpse after an attendant turns up missing. When Conan tries to solve the mystery by staying after-hours, he finds himself trapped in the dark.

episodes_data.title: Driving a Bomb
episodes_data.description: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Conan, Richard, and Rachel to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end.

episodes_data.title: The Mist Goblin Murder
episodes_data.description: A baffling and seemingly impossible murder is committed at a secluded mountain temple. Luckily Conan and Richard are on the scene! It is believed that the terrible Mist Goblin, a creature with super strength, haunts the temple. Conan doesn`t believe in goblins, but he may have to change his tune as the evidence suggests that the Mist Goblin may be more than just a legend!

episodes_data.title: Weapon of Choice
episodes_data.description: When a man is found murdered, three suspects emerge. But even if one of them committed the crime, how did they do it when none of them were anywhere near the victim? That’s what Conan intends to figure out!

episodes_data.title: Game Gone Bad
episodes_data.description: The past returns to haunt the President of a video game company when a bomb destroys part of his building and kills a seemingly innocent victim!

episodes_data.title: Train Trick
episodes_data.description: Conan’s got a maddening new riddle: If a train departs the station at 10:30, and another train arrives at 10:35, how can a man on one train kill a man on the other?

episodes_data.title: The Sunfish Murder
episodes_data.description: Conan’s on the case when the manager of a cleaning company is crushed by a piece of steel, but he encounters only dead ends in the alleyway where the murder was committed.

episodes_data.title: Footsteps of the Hero: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan’s invitation to an elite Sherlock Holmes tour has him rubbing elbows with fellow Holmes fans, but when one of the guests is murdered, can the group solve the case before the killer strikes again?

episodes_data.title: Footsteps of the Hero: Part 2
episodes_data.description: The murderer is still on the loose and his methods have even the most diehard Sherlock Holmes fans completely baffled. The mystery thickens as Conan tries to crack the case!

episodes_data.title: Shopping Can Be Murder
episodes_data.description: The Junior Detective League is back on the case when a young boy becomes the unknowing target of a killer! Conan and his friends must use every trick in their book to protect the tiny tot.

episodes_data.title: Illustrated Murder
episodes_data.description: A popular illustrator finds his life falling apart after an affair with a young colleague. Rather than face his mistakes, he tries to cover them up in brutal fashion. Can Conan see through his ingenious plot?

episodes_data.title: Ghost Ship Murder: Part 1
episodes_data.description: When Richard travels to Kiji Island, Chief Mikami forces him to find a billion dollars in gold that was lost off the shores - and the death toll is rising. Are the killings the result of the Pirate’s Curse?

episodes_data.title: Ghost Ship Murder: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Richard faces a murder wrap and it’s up to Conan to clear his name. In order to solve the mystery, the young sleuth realizes he must go where no one else will: into the eerie darkness of the Pirates’ Cave!

episodes_data.title: Gomera!
episodes_data.description: The Junior Detective League visits the film set of their favorite monster, Gomera. When they stumble onto a real-life murder, the most puzzling aspect of the case is the prime suspect: Gomera!

episodes_data.title: The Three Fingerprints
episodes_data.description: Richard’s old friend is suspected of murder. It is up to Conan to find the clues and piece together the truth that will either condemn Richard’s mentor or set him free!

episodes_data.title: The Crab and Whale
episodes_data.description: A relaxing night turns into a search for a kidnapped little boy. As Conan, Richard, and Rachel try to find the truth, nothing is certain except the kidnapper’s deadly ultimatum: no police, no mercy, no time!

episodes_data.title: Moonless Murder
episodes_data.description: How can blood from a murder on the street end up on the wall of an abandoned building, on the railing of a rooftop, and on the broken glass of an upper-apartment window? This is the question Conan must answer.

episodes_data.title: The Case of the Murdered Actress
episodes_data.description: Conan joins the Moores at a playhouse that is plagued by threats of violence from an unknown nemesis. When a cast member is murdered, it is up to Conan, and an old acquaintance of Richard’s, to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Knight Baron Mystery: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan, Richard, and Rachel are offered a free stay at a posh hotel if they join a mystery tour. They must uncover the identity of the tour promoter who is posing as one of the guests - and as the Knight Baron!

episodes_data.title: Knight Baron Mystery: Part 2
episodes_data.description: One of the tour members is murdered! And since he`s dressed as the Knight Baron, it’s assumed that the victim is also the promoter. But which of the other tour members would murder the promoter - and why?

episodes_data.title: Knight Baron Mystery: Part 3
episodes_data.description: Just when Conan thinks he`s close to solving the puzzle, the unexpected happens: the Knight Baron appears again! But if the victim wasn`t the tour promoter - who is?

episodes_data.title: The Stalker
episodes_data.description: Richard, Conan, and Rachel discover a corpse in the street. While the police believe the incident to be a random murder, the victim’s past leads Conan to pin the blame on the most unassuming suspect of all!

episodes_data.title: Triple Terror
episodes_data.description: Conan and Rachel find themselves embroiled in a murder at a private beach. However, even more disturbing than the brutal death is the list of prime suspects: the victim’s triplet sons!

episodes_data.title: The Shipwreck Murder
episodes_data.description: An S.O.S. message in a bottle disrupts Conan’s beachside vacation. Can he and his Junior Detective League friends find the young woman they believe to be the note’s author?

episodes_data.title: Jinnai, King of Death
episodes_data.description: When a killer claiming to be the King of Death sends a threat to movie star, Conan, Richard, and Rachel must stop the culprit from making good on his warning: At the stroke of Midnight, you will die!

episodes_data.title: Murder and Mahjong
episodes_data.description: Mahjong: a game of strategy, skill, and luck - three things that a sinister murderer hopes he has on his side! Conan must stack the clues and place details in order if he is to win this terrifying game!

episodes_data.title: Phantom Thief 1412
episodes_data.description: When a priceless jewelry exhibit comes to town, so does Phantom Thief, a famous burglar who leaves a note announcing his intentions to steal the Black Star-the most valuable pearl in the world. When the police corner Phantom Thief on the top of a building, it looks like his amazing career is over until he uses a flash bomb to blind his would be captors and make a harrowing escape. All that remains of the Phantom is a note announcing his next move: to steal the Black Star during an anniversary party on board the Queen Isabelle.

episodes_data.title: Mysterious Masked Murder: Part 1
episodes_data.description: When Richard is hired to find wealthy Gerard Dufour’s childhood sweetheart, a murder takes place right under his nose - and the prime suspect turns up dead.

episodes_data.title: Mysterious Masked Murder: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Conan and Harley Hartwell’s covert investigation continues. But with precious few suspects, one big question haunts the brilliant duo: If Roland Dufour didn’t commit the murder, then who did?

episodes_data.title: The Revengeful Robber
episodes_data.description: Conan and Rachel become embroiled in a bank robbery that ends in murder. Just when Inspector Meguire thinks he’s solved the crime, Conan discovers a hidden agenda that busts the case wide-open!

episodes_data.title: Dead Hobo
episodes_data.description: When the Junior Detective League sets out to help an ailing homeless man, they end up involved in a new murder mystery. They know who did it - but can they get anyone to listen to them?

episodes_data.title: Two Times Trouble: Part 1
episodes_data.description: The Junior Detective League witnesses the abduction of a famous singing duo. When the kidnappers contact Conan and his friends, the police must place the victims’ lives in the hands of the youthful sleuths.

episodes_data.title: Two Times Trouble: Part 2
episodes_data.description: The Junior Detective League must rescue the hostage singers, stop the mysterious kidnappers, and risk their lives - all in time for the sold-out Two-Times concert!

episodes_data.title: The Set Up
episodes_data.description: Richard witnesses a murder in the hospital, but his eyes may be playing tricks on him: he sees the same scene four nights in a row! Things get even stranger when he emerges as the prime suspect!

episodes_data.title: Massacre Night: Part 1
episodes_data.description: While out skiing, Rachel, Serena, and Conan bump into one of Rachel’s childhood teachers -  and a sinister looking reporter who shares an ominous warning.

episodes_data.title: Massacre Night: Part 2
episodes_data.description: After Serena was attacked, the words MASSACRE NIGHT were found written on her hand! Conan leaps into action to uncover the truth, but sometimes the truth is too much to handle.

episodes_data.title: Find the Kidnap Site!
episodes_data.description: The Junior Detective League is after a kidnapper who has dubious intentions. There’s more than one life at stake if Conan can’t figure out where the captive child is hidden!

episodes_data.title: For the Birds
episodes_data.description: Conan and Rachel take Richard on a crane-watching trip, but the man responsible for the birds’ well being is found murdered! The victim’s son turns himself in, but Conan suspects the guy is innocent!

episodes_data.title: Vampire Villa: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan must untangle a bizarre murder that seems to revolve around an old vampire film when he visits Castle Dredula, home of horror novelist Stefan Van Croven.

episodes_data.title: Vampire Villa: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Horror novelist Stefan Van Croven has been pierced through the chest with a wooden stake! Richard is convinced that the answer is right under his nose, but he doesn’t know that Conan’s figured out the trick!

episodes_data.title: Deadly Art
episodes_data.description: Richard is asked to investigate a murder threat against Rika Okano, a respected artist who is up for an award. The threat is simple: If Rika receives the award, she will be murdered!

episodes_data.title: Hospital Homicide
episodes_data.description: After Richard breaks his leg, Conan’s stops by to visit and senses all is not right with Moore’s hospital roommates. His suspicions are justified when a high stakes game of kidnapping and murder begins!

episodes_data.title: Mountain Fox: Part 1
episodes_data.description: On a mountain-climbing trip, Conan must stop the assassination of one of Richard’s clients. The would-be assailant is a contract killer known as the Fox - and he might be posing as a fellow mountain climber.

episodes_data.title: Mountain Fox: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Conan is faced with the task of tracking the Fox, the world’s most notorious assassin, after the mysterious death of two campers. Can Conan stop him from killing again?

episodes_data.title: The Other Girl
episodes_data.description: A wonderland of wintertime fun becomes a stage for tragedy following the death of an actress at the peak of her career. But a suicide note and a history of poor health don’t always add up to the obvious.

episodes_data.title: Kogorou's Deadly Date
episodes_data.description: Richard’s set to reunite with a childhood friend, but what happens is more than Richard ever could have imagined. What do an old ink pen, a security camera, and three children add up to? Murder!

episodes_data.title: Shinichi Kudou Revealed
episodes_data.description: Rachel sets out to solve a mystery of her own when a startling discovery leads to clues that could expose Conan’s secret identity.

episodes_data.title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
episodes_data.description: Conan, Rachel, and Richard visit the home of a billionaire who is dying of heart disease. Everyone under the roof is fighting over his estate - and somebody is about to violently raise the stakes.

episodes_data.title: Potter's Gambit: Part 1
episodes_data.description: While visiting a famous potter, Conan, Richard, and Rachel stumble upon what they believe to be a suicide - but was it? As the detectives soon learn, looks can often times be deceiving.

episodes_data.title: Potter's Gambit: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Conan tries to unravel the mystery of Margery Taylor’s apparent suicide, but how can he prove a murder took place when all of the suspects - including Richard, Rachel, and himself - share the same alibi?

episodes_data.title: The Memories of First Love: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Rachel and Conan join Annette, one of Jimmy’s old flames, on a weekend getaway. When the villa catches fire, Rachel risks her life to save her competition. Was the fire an accident? Or is something sinister afoot?

episodes_data.title: The Memories of First Love: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Conan quickly figures out the complicated method the arsonist used to torch the house, as well as the motive behind it. But after the case is solved, Jimmy is in for an embarrassing surprise of his own.

episodes_data.title: Fame and Misfortune: Part 1
episodes_data.description: A movie star hires Richard to advise him for a role as a detective. But the line between fact and fiction blurs when Richard, Rachel, and Conan discover they have front row seats to an act of murder!

episodes_data.title: Fame and Misfortune: Part 2
episodes_data.description: As the media flocks to the high-profile murder case, the police prepare to charge a movie star with murder. Can Conan prove he knows who actually committed the crime?

episodes_data.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor: Part 1
episodes_data.description: When Conan and Rachel join Richard for a trip to Bludcraven Manor, they learn of a troubling secret that may link Morfius Bludcraven, the original lord of the estate, to a band of thieves known as The Goblins!

episodes_data.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor: Part 2
episodes_data.description: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to decipher a secret code that promises to solve the strange mysteries of Bludcraven Manor. The unsuspecting sleuths have no clue that the goblins they hunt are very real!

episodes_data.title: Snapshots of Death
episodes_data.description: When a photographer wins an award for capturing a fire on film, it seems like his career has been made - but when Richard accuses him of being a murderer on TV, one of their careers is about to go up in smoke!

episodes_data.title: The Mysterious Moletian Case: Part 1
episodes_data.description: A distraught man visits Richard about his murdered sister, but things just don’t add up. A jewelry store heist and a car chase lead Conan back to the scene of the crime as another case unfolds.

episodes_data.title: The Mysterious Moletian Case: Part 2
episodes_data.description: A suspected murder, a jewel heist, and a missing body have Conan and the Junior Detective League working every angle to crack the case. Will Conan be able to put the clues together in time?

episodes_data.title: Hit and Run
episodes_data.description: When a killer spies the Junior Detective League on TV, he decides to use them for his own evil purposes. Can Conan and his pals see through his plan or will they unwittingly help him get away with murder?

episodes_data.title: Recipe for Murder: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan tags along with Rachel to a cooking class, only to discover all of the students despise their instructor. When the lights go out during class and the instructor collapses, there’s mystery on the menu!

episodes_data.title: Recipe for Murder: Part 2
episodes_data.description: All four suspects had a reason to stab their cooking instructor in the back. But what was the murder weapon, where is it hidden, and how was the killer able to strike in a pitch-black kitchen?

episodes_data.title: School of Ghouls
episodes_data.description: Intruders and disappearances lead to rumors that Teitan Elementary School is haunted. The Junior Detective League springs into action, and Conan senses that a few teachers are covering something up.

episodes_data.title: Prescription for Murder
episodes_data.description: Rachel and Conan discover a woman’s body, and the victim’s best friend accuses the Medical Examiner of murder. The Doctor is definitely a heel, but is he really guilty of murder?

episodes_data.title: Scuba Dying: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Conan and the gang befriend a group of university students at an ocean resort. When a banded sea snake attacks, a life hangs in the balance!  Can Conan uncover the truth behind an attempted murder?

episodes_data.title: Scuba Dying: Part 2
episodes_data.description: A young woman is barely clinging to life and every individual in the group of college students is a suspect. Can Conan make sense of it in time? Or will a murderer escape without a trace?

episodes_data.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance: Part 1
episodes_data.description: Popular writer Jonathan Nantz has been missing for two months. The plot thickens when Conan realizes that Nantz has embedded hidden codes in his new novel - with clues to his perplexing disappearance!

episodes_data.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance: Part 2

episodes_data.title: The Forgotten Bond: Part 2

When the witch drifts, the tire makes a sound that sound like a woman screaming. Yamamura reveals his grandma raced against the witch but gave up when the witch drove into the air. Kogoro decides to investigate on the identity of the witch and returns to Mount Fuyana the next day, taking Conan and Ran with him in Orange Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution X (CZ4A). Upon meeting the witch, Kogoro has a drag race with her but stops when Conan reveals that the witch drove into a road less area. Kogoro tells Yamamura to stop all White FD drivers and wait for his arrival. Once there, Kogoro interrogates the three suspect pairs in order to find out which one of them is the witch.

episodes_data.description: Sera heads to the rental villa to meet a client with Conan, Ran, and Sonoko. On their way, Ran and Sonoko spot a woman dressed in red from head to toe. At the rental villa, Tamami, Sumika, Ninda, and Hakuya, members of a former high school outdoor club, had gathered. 15 years prior, a wife stabbed her husband to death at a nearby villa.

episodes_data.title: Tragedy of the Red Woman (Evil Spirit)
episodes_data.description: Hakuya`s body is discovered, and the Nagano police led by Uehara Yoshie begin their investigation. Uehara believes the culprit struck Hakuya on the back of the head with a blunt object and knocked him unconscious before drowning him in the bathtub.

episodes_data.title: Tragedy of the Red Woman (Revenge)
episodes_data.description: Sumika is attacked by someone resembling the Red Woman, but the cut is shallow, and Uehara treats her with antiseptic. Uehara explains there was no mistake in the DNA test of the Red Woman. However, Uehera adds since over ten years ago around this time of year, rental villas in the area are robbed.

episodes_data.title: The Comedian Who Turned Himself In (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Comedian DoDonPa Rokusuke turns himself in at a police box for the murder of his talent agency`s president Tendo Hideki. True to his testimony, Tendo is discovered at the agency dead from a blow to the head, and DoDonPa claims he struck the president with the metal bat found beside the body.

episodes_data.title: The Comedian Who Turned Himself In (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan feels something is wrong with DoDonPa`s all too convenient alibi and begins to strongly suspect him. After taking on the guilt for a murder he didn`t commit, DoDonPa becomes the man of the hour for trying to protect the reputation of his benefactor Tendo.

episodes_data.title: The Romance Novel with the Unexpected Conclusion (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the hotel room where Sera is living. In the hallway on the 30th floor of Sera`s hotel, editors A, B, and C wait for author Hiura Keigo to finish his manuscripts. Later, Hiura`s assistant Minazuki Chiori is found murdered in the room directly below Hiura`s.

episodes_data.title: The Romance Novel with the Unexpected Conclusion (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Author Keigo Hiura`s assistant Chiaki Minazuki is found strangled to death in a hotel. Hiura has a perfect alibi, but Conan and Sera are certain he committed the crime. They ask about the condition of Minazuki`s room and get closer to the truth. A 20 year old postcard is discovered inside Minazuki`s suitcase. It is addressed to Hiura, and the sender is not Minazuki but Jun Ota, which is also the name of the heroine in Hiura`s "The Phone, the Ocean, and I". Later a casual remark from Takagi helps Conan and Sera realize how Hiura manipulated his alibi...

episodes_data.title: Kaga Hyakumangoku Mystery Tour (Kanazawa Arc)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran arrive in Ishikawa Prefecture`s Kanazawa and are met by tourism agency employees Yuzo Tanimoto and Moeko Miyazawa and event company president Yuya Tadokoro and his employees Osamu Kuranishi and Harumi Akiyama. They have asked for Kogoro`s help with the Kaga Hyakumangoku Mystery Tour city revitalization event to be held in the Kanazawa.

episodes_data.title: Kaga Hyakumangoku Mystery Tour (Kaga Hot Springs Arc)
episodes_data.description: Ran accompanies Akiyama to the hospital after she is attacked while Kogoro and the others continue visiting the checkpoints. After arriving at the Kanazawa 21st Century Museum, Conan chckes the four cards that fell out of Akiyama`s bag.

episodes_data.title: Conan and Heiji's Code of Love (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: On a rainy day, Conan bumps into a suspicious man being purused by police. The man is a drug dealer, and he drops his notebook as he flees. The notebook contains a code written using subway station and line numbers, but some of the code washed away in the rain.

episodes_data.title: Conan and Heiji's Code of Love (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: When Heiji arrives at Nihonbashi, the scene of the drug deal, he finds three people wearing or holding white roses. Heiji trasmits images of the three people to Conan using his cell phone.

episodes_data.title: Teimuzu River Kite Flying Case (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Genta, and Mitsuhiko enter the Teimuzu River Kite Flying Event. Renno and Yatsukoshi form the opposing team. Yatsukoshi holds the kite string while Renno holds their kite and speaks on the phone with his wife Takami.

episodes_data.title: Teimuzu River Kite Flying Case (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Renno is led between two posts without a rope barrier and falls into the river. Yatsukoshi, who had feelings for Renno`s mistress, Kakura, whose younger sister had her emotions toyed with, and Takami, whose husband cheated on her, all had motives.

episodes_data.title: The Lover Gone Missing in a Snowstorm
episodes_data.description: Conan, Agasa, and the kids visit a boarding house where they are greeted by Ryoko, Aya, and Juri, the three sisters who manage the building. Conan happens upon Aya and Juri`s boyfriend Masahiko arguing. Aya is strongly opposed to Juri`s relationship with Masahiko, who is known for being a bad boy.

episodes_data.title: Haibara Ai Imprisonment Case
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends search for Ai, who disappeared on her way home from shopping. She is bound and imprisoned by a robber inside the home of her recent acquaintance Higaki Mitsuru along with Mitsuru herself.

episodes_data.title: The Troublesome Emergency Patient
episodes_data.description: While Conan and his friends are on their way home from school, a man being chased by the police grabs Ayumi and uses her as a shield. Later, the man passes out from an injury on the back of his head. Emergency medical doctor Kido and nurse Natsumi treat the man, but he remains unconscious and in serious condition.

episodes_data.title: The Tense Tea Party (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A visitor named Reina is killed at Haido Central Hospital. The cause of death is asphyxiation caused by cyanide. Inspector Megure suspects hospital patient Juri and visitors Katsuki and Tokie, who were drinking tea with the victim.

episodes_data.title: The Tense Tea Party (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: The police fail to find the container used to hold the poison that killed Reina in the hospital room, and Megure believes it`s likely the culprit took it outside to dispose of it.

episodes_data.title: Kudo Shinichi Aquarium Case (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran go to the Beika Aquarium where Ran and Shinichi once went on a date. During their date, a man was stabbed to death. The knife used in the stabbing was modified to prevent the victim`s blood from getting on the culprit.

episodes_data.title: Kudo Shinichi Aquarium Case (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While Shinichi and Ran are on a date at the Beika Aquarium, Shumoto is stabbed to death. Shinichi and Inspector Megure question Naho, Kanoko, and Jinbe, the people Shumoto was communicating with using his phone.

episodes_data.title: Munch's Missing Scream
episodes_data.description: An exhibition of Munch`s work is being held at the Suzuki Museum. Munch`s "Despair" and "Anxiety" are delivered to Narita Airport and packed by shipping company president Shimamura and his employees. Later, the truck transporting "Despair" and "Anxiety" depart for the Suzuki Museum, with the limousine carrying Conan, Ran, and Jirokichi following close behind.

episodes_data.title: The Manipulated Great Detective (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Inspector Megure asks Kogoro for help disguising himself as a famous safecracker and infiltrating a gang of thieves. However, the gang boss Mr. Head sees through his disguise. The man who killed Head`s son is among his subordinates, and he instructs Kogoro to work with the gang as planned to determine the killer`s identity.

episodes_data.title: The Manipulated Great Detective (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro are taken to a warehouse by the gang of thieves to wait for their boss Mr. Head. Suddenly Head`s metallic altered voice comes over the speakers. Kogoro looks at his watch and panics when he sees the time is 2:30 in the morning. If he doesn`t determine who killed Head`s son by dawn, Ran will be killed by an assassin.

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys vs the Silver Detectives
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko meet the Silver Detectives Tokunaga, Mutsuhiko, Ginta, and Yasuko who find a stolen bicycle. The next day, a young man named Kuroda is found dead in his home. The Silver Detectives are the first to discover the body. While pursuing a hooligan they caught littering, they chased him into the house where they found the body.

episodes_data.title: Mirage of the Disappearing Angel
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is hired to find the missing painter Aoki by his wife. Conan determines Aoki is in Tokugawa Prefecture`s Uozo from the painting Aoki sent his wife Midori. Kogoro, Conan, Ran, and Midori discover Aoki`s drowned corpse in Uozu. They investigate the inn where Aoki was staying and interview the manager Hayashi. When Conan sees the painting in the photo, he noticies something was added. The data from the day Aoki took the photo had been erased from his digital camera. Later, permanent part-timer Akagi, traveler Shirakawa, and fisherman Ishiguro all emerge as suspects...

episodes_data.title: The Scarlet Prologue
episodes_data.description: Amuro witnesses a woman pushed from the top of the stairs at Haido Park. However, he doesn`t see the culprit`s face. The unconscious and gravely injured woman pushed from the stairs is Jodie`s friend and Haido Elementary School teacher Natsuko. Conan and Jodie head to the park and determine Natsuko was attacked somewhere else, and it soon becomes clear she was assaulted at the school. Later, Megure and the police question her coworker Sugamoto, who tried to give Natsuko a ride home, and Ueno and Kandachi, parents of students with appointments to see Natsuko...

episodes_data.title: The Scarlet Pursuit
episodes_data.description: Elementary school teacher Natsuko is struck while working at school and pushed off the stairs in front of the park. Conan and his companions question Sugamoto, another teacher who had planned to walk her home, and parents Ueno and Kandachi, who had appointments to meet with Natsuko. Conan notices something strange while listening to their stories. Later, the police review a photo of the answer sheets Natsuko was grading. Jodie and Camel fail to discover any information that could help them solve the crime from the photo, but Amuro and Conan realize who the culprit is after seeing the picture.

episodes_data.title: The Scarlet Intersection
episodes_data.description: When Conan hears Camel`s story, he realizes Vermouth disguised herself as Jodie and spoke with him. Conan is frustrated the he acted just as Bourbon (Amuro) and Vermouth planned. Amuro meets with Vermouth, who is still disguised as Jodie. She informs him she learned from Camel that Kusuda shot himself. Amuro responds that there was another burned man who was shot in the head when Kusuda disappeared with thoughts of FBI agent Akai Shuichi on his mind. Amuro deduces Akai is still alive, but...

episodes_data.title: The Scarlet Return
episodes_data.description: Amuro visits Okiya at the Edo family home and begins explaining how one corpse was swapped out for another. Akai was shot in the head and burned along with his car at Raiha Pass. However, Amuro believes Akai switched his own body out for Kusuda`s and is in fact still alive. Amuro explains Akai`s trick step by step to Okiya. Meanwhile, Jodie was thinking the same thing as Amuro. Amuro reasons the body swap was planned not by Akai but by Conan. Amuro then asks Okiya to remove his mask. He is certain Okiya is Akai, but...

episodes_data.title: The Scarlet Truth
episodes_data.description: Akai suddenly appears in the back seat of Jodie`s car and fires at the secret police`s vehicles. The bullet strikes a tire, and the FBI agents successfully shake off the secret police. Meanwhile, at the Kudo family home Amuro`s subordinates inform him Akai shot out a tire, causing their cars to crash. Later, Jodie`s car returns to the crash site. Akai takes a cell phone from the secret police and begins speaking to Amuro (Bourbon). He tells him it was a mistake to let Conan know he had the nickname Zero. Akai knew who Amuro truly was...

episodes_data.title: Welcome to Club Orihime
episodes_data.description: Sonoko`s acquaintance Chikada Eimi has her hair cut by someone at high school. Three days earlier and the day before, other students were the victims similar incidents. Before the incidents, warning letters were left in the box of Club Orihime, the romantic help desk Eimi and her friends set up at the school. This morning they received a letter stating, "EC will be brought to justice!" The letters are the initials of the victim. At the scene of the crime, they find a new letter stating, "TB dies as sundown tonight!" Only two hours remain until sunset. To prevent another incident from occurring, Conan and his friends search for a student with the initials TB...

episodes_data.title: Taiko Meijin's Match of Love (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Haneda Shukichi, also known as Taiko Meijin, takes on Katsumata Chikara in a meijin title match in Yamanashi Prefecture. Just before the second day`s match begins, Shukichi receives a threatening letter from a man calling himself the Headless Shogi Player who claims to have kidnapped Shukichi`s girlfriend Miyamoto Yumi. In order to save Yumi, Shukichi announces he needs time to think and takes a taxi to Tokyo. Interpreting the code labelled "first game," Shukichi arrives at Meiji Jingu where he runs into Conan and his friends as they visit power spots. The code pointed to Kato Kiyomasa`s well. After hearing about the situation, Conan searches the area around the well and discovers the second game`s code left behind by the culprit...

episodes_data.title: Taiko Meijin's Match of Love (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: During his Meijin title match, Haneda Shukichi receives a threatening letter from a man calling himself the Headless Shogi Player who claims to have kidnapped his girlfriend Yumi. Conan solves the second game`s code and arrives at a grave on Yureizaka.

episodes_data.title: The Mystery Sinking in the Midsummer Pool (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends go to a hotel pool where Nagami, daughter of the president of Oiso Finance, drowns to death. She had been wearing a diving tank and searching the pool for her lost necklace. Based on the crime scene, Inspector Megure believes it may have been an accident. However, the hotel bellboys claim the body in the pool suddenly appeared.

episodes_data.title: The Mystery Sinking in the Midsummer Pool (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Nagami`s body is discovered in the hotel pool. Megure questions Samaki, Hamaka, and Toyoshima regarding the actions they took after they left Nagami alone in the pool. According to the pool reception staff, between the presumed hour of Nagami`s death between noon and 1 PM, Toyoshima, Samaki, and Hamaka each came to the pool in that order. Later, the bellboys describe the situation at the pool while they were searching for Nagami, leading Conan and Sera to investigate the pool and discover which of her three acquaintances murdered her. They reproduce the manner in which the body disappeared in an experiment, bringing them closer to the culprit...

episodes_data.title: The Queen's Weather Forecast
episodes_data.description: A weather forecaster falls to her death after leaning on a second-floor railing, but Conan notices several suspicious things about the body.

episodes_data.title: Bekapon's Bleeding Service
episodes_data.description: Supermarket Beikado employee Kanzaki receives death threats over the phone. He hires Kogoro to investigate the threats, but Kogoro believes it to be a prank played by a friend. However, an incident occurs the following day on Sunday. A man wearing a ski mask appears at Beikado. While shouting, "Die, Kanzaki," he stabs the man dressed in Beikado`s mascot Bekapon costume and runs away. The victim is employee Shimomura. Every Sunday, Kanzaki interacts with customers dressed as Bekapon, but due to a stomach ache, Shimomura wore the costume in his place. Megure believes the culprit accidentally stabbed Shimomura, but Conan notices something puzzling about the case...

episodes_data.title: Detective Takagi on the Run in Handcuffs
episodes_data.description: Conan and friends witness waiter Someya punching his coworker Nashimoto at a family restaurant. Nearby, Chie trembles in fear for some reason. Three days later, Detective Takagi is escorting Someya to the Metropolitan Police Department in a patrol car, and Someya bungles his escape attempt. Takagi and Someya find themselves alone and handcuffed together. Takagi tries to determine why Someya attempted to flee, but... Conan learns about their situation while watching the news and goes to question Nashimoto. Nashimoto confesses Chie was being talked by Someya. While it`s likelly Someya will go to see Chie, Conan thinks something seems not quite right...

episodes_data.title: Three First Discoverers (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends notice a young boy looking at an apartment from an alleyway and call out to him. The woman who lives in the apartment asked the boy to call the police if she didn`t exit her room after three men came and left her apartment, as it would mean she was likely dead. Conan and his friends discover scriptwriter Yasue dead from hanging in the room. Based on the situation, Megure determines it was a murder. However, the men Shibakaru, Sakaba, and Habanaka who visited the room all claim she was already dead when they came to the room. The case has three first discoverers...

episodes_data.title: Three First Discoverers (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Scriptwriter Yasue is found dead in her apartment hanging from a noose. Shibakaru, Sakaba, and Hamanaka all testify she was already dead when they visited her apartment during the presumed time of her death, and Megure believes she may have killed herself. Near the body are scattered 500 thousand yen and roughly a hundred pages of manuscript paper, but Megure determines they would not have been enough to stand on. After questioning, Conan uses his smart phone to investigate the three year old case of a group of thieves who murdered a couple and stole two million yen and learns the name of Yasue`s young friend is Ganno Mamoru. Conan has already arrived at the truth of the situation.

episodes_data.title: Bodyguard Mori Kogoro
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran accompany actresses Haneki Ryo and Sawazaki Reina to the on-location shoot of their gourmet travels TV show. After several attempts on her life, Ryo feels she is in danger. Kogoro is hired to protect Ryo as her bodyguard and determine who is trying to kill her.

episodes_data.title: The Secret of the Missing Young Lady
episodes_data.description: On her way home from school, Ayumi sees Makabe carrying the unconscious body of his wife Yuri to his car. Believing the young married woman she sometimes visited was murdered by her husband, Ayumi and the Detective Boys return to the house to investigate. They are confronted by Makabe while they are looking around the yard. When they ask him where his wife is, he answers that she is in the mountains. Conan and his friends also question a deliveryman who says he heard someone scream in the house the day before. Convinced that murder is a real possibility, they enter the house using a spare key and find a mysterious doll that was not there before as well as dried blood on the floor...

episodes_data.title: The Lovebirds' Ruse
episodes_data.description: Mystery writer Kanbayashi falls to his death in the alley between apartment buildings A and B. He fell from the hallway of the fifth floor of building A where his office is located. When he fell, for some reason Kanbayashi changed from his socks into sneakers and was wearing gloves. Megure questions the victim`s wife Seiko and first one to discover the body as well as Sugiyama, building A`s security guard. It seems Kanbayashi and Seiko were a couple of lovebirds. As the police proceed with the investigation, an accident, murder, and suicide all seem like possibilities. Countless mysteries surround the death, and Kanbashi`s actions were mysterious as well. Conan narrows his focus and quickly draws closer to the truth of the fall, but...

episodes_data.title: The Dreaming Girl's Confused Deduction
episodes_data.description: Conan unexpectedly finds himself helping college student Funako find Hikone, a job-hopper who has been missing for two days. They visit Hikone`s apartment and meet college stduent Kiyose who lives on his right and former office worker Nashida who lives on his left, but gain no useful information from either of them.

episodes_data.title: The Moving Target
episodes_data.description: Conan witnesses office worker Fukurokoji Sadao fall off the roof of a ten story building. Fukurokoji seems to be falling directly towards office worker Komatsu Hitoshi, who is standing in the alleyway, but Conan kicks a ball into him, and he falls into a nearby heap of garbage and survives. At first it was thought to be an attempted suicide by Fukurokoji, but Inspector Megure determines someone carried the plastered drunk Fukurokoji to the roof and pushed him off, making it an attempted murder. After investigating the rooftop, Conan questions Komatsu, and he deduces that the murderer was attempting to kill not only Fukurokoji, but Komatsu as well. He tries to find someone bearing a grudge against them both, but...

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys' Locked Room Mystery Battle
episodes_data.description: Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Ai go to the site of a demolished mansion owned by Professor Agasa`s acquaintance to practice soccer, but when they get there they find the police conducting an investigation. The body of a man was found floating in the pool inside the lot. He died to a blow to the back of the head by a blunt object, and the gate to the lot was unlocked by Agasa, who arrived earlier. The lot is surrounded by a brick wall, and on top of the wall are glass shards and barbed wire. The gate was last opened three days prior, but the victim is presumed to have died before midnight last night. The incident occurred in a roofless locked lot. The Detective Boys try to tackle the locked room mystery, but...

episodes_data.title: After That Hundred Million Yen
episodes_data.description: The soon to be five year old daughter Reina of black marketing lending company president Saeki and his wife Hiroko is kidnapped. The kidnapper demands they bring a 100 million yen ransom to Beika Central Park. He choosestheir housekeeper Suzuko to transport the money, and Conan finds it odd he didn`t choose a family member. Following Kogoro`s advice, Megure has GPS transmitters attached to the bag containing the ransom money, under the car, and in the brooch on Suzuko`s breast. After arriving at the park, wary of transmitters, the kidnapper instructs Suzuko to change cars and bags over the phone. Furthermore, the kidnapper issues instructions to Suzuko to outwit the police and foil their plans...

episodes_data.title: The Tottori Sand Dunes Mystery Tour (Kurayoshi Arc)
episodes_data.description: During a visit to Tottori, Kogoro, Conan, and Ran come across a case. Shuko, wife of the Kumado family`s eldest son, had her hands and feet bound by a robber, and the family`s heirloom incense burner was stolen. A pedant found at the crime scene casts suspicion on the family`s former housekeeper Naomi, but Kogoro and his family saw her at the sand museum at the time of the crime. Later, head of the household Kumado Isao receives an e-mail on his phone demanding 10 million yen in exchange for the incense burner. Kogoro suspects the crime was committed by a family member who was trying to frame Naomi, and investigates the alibis of Isao, eldest daughter Makie, eldest son Soichi, and second son Junji, but...

episodes_data.title: The Tottori Sand Dunes Mystery Tour (Tottori Arc)
episodes_data.description: The heirloom incense burner of the Kumado family, a prominent local family, is stolen. The thief returns the incense burner, but Detective Yamane follows Kogoro`s theory that a member of the family is the thief and thoroughly investigates the alibis of Iwao, Makie, Soichi, and Junji. Conan finds Naomi`s alibi odd and questions her uncle Adachi. According to him, two years ago Naomi witnessed Shuko meeting with a man on the Tottori sand dunes and had been using the information to blackmail her. Hearing Adachi`s story, Conan realizes why Shuko had been tied up and draws closer to the truth behind the case... However, the real crime is about to occur...

episodes_data.title: The Pitfall of Fire Precautions
episodes_data.description: Three arson cases occur at children`s playgrounds. Conan and his friends conduct a stake out at the lunch vendor used by the man they saw running from the crime scene. Last year, four fires were started at children`s playgrounds, but the suspect was never arrested. Kamaishi, the man they saw the previous night, appears at the lunch vendor, and Conan and his friends follow him. Later, a fire is started at the same playground where the previous year`s fourth fire occurred. Apparently Kamaishi was also watching the area to catch the arsonist. The next morning, the Detective Boys and Kamaishi go to investigate the fires together. Conan visits the various crime scenes and notices a certain rule...

episodes_data.title: Conan and Ebizo's Kabuki Juhachiban Mystery (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan prevents an accident involving a out-of-control car with no working breaks. Someone poked holes in the brake hose, and the police investigate the incident as an attempted murder. The driver Hosoo was on his way to deliver a valuable double-sided mask to Ichikawa Ebizo, who is rehearsing at the kabuki theater. Ebizo plans to use the mask at next month`s performance of "Nanatsu Men." The chairman Matsubara takes the mask from Hosoo and keeps it in a locker during rehearsal, but the next morning, they discover the mask has been stolen. Hosoo`s secretary Takahashi is also found dead inside a car. In the passenger seat is an empty duralumin case that contained the mask. Conan investigates the rehearsal space and determines it is very likely the thief is involved in the play, and Ebizo is moved by Conan`s sharp detective skills. Later, Conan and Ebizo look for the thief together...

episodes_data.title: Conan and Ebizo's Kabuki Juhachiban Mystery (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While on his way to meet Kaneko, Conan is kidnapped. After losing consciousness, Conan awakens in the dark basement of a building being demolished. From overhead he hears the defeaning roar of heavy machinery drilling through concrete. Realizing he doesn`t have his phone, he attempts to use his Detective Boys badge to call for help, but there is no answer. Meanwhile, Ran and the Detective Boys become concerned that Conan still hasn`t come home. When Ai learns they can`t get in touch with him, she uses a GPS to locate Conan`s phone. They find it in a narrow alleyway in Ginza. Believing he may be the victim of a kidnapping related to the case, they turn on their badges and wait for him to respond...

episodes_data.title: The Ventriloquist's Illusion (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: The ventriloquist Tengan puts on a show about a ventriloquist who becomes possessed by hiis doll and murders his wife. Tengan falls victim to a genuine split personality disorder, and the personality of his doll appears and orders him to kill his wife Kazuko. Tengan asks Kogoro to watch him so he doesn`t kill his wife Kazuko, who had an affair with his apprentice Togawa, but Kogoro turns him down, saying it`s not his field of expertise. The next morning, Kazuko is found murdered. Tengan confesses that he may have killed his wife while he was unaware, but...

episodes_data.title: The Ventriloquist's Illusion (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Ventriloquist Tengan`s wife Kazuko is bludgeoned to death with a trophy. Afflicted by multiple personality disorder, Tengan confesses that he may have killed her while he was unaware, but based on the circumstances, Tengan`s apprentice Togawa, who was having an affair with Kazuko, rises as a suspect. Conan feels as though something is wrong with the case and investigates Tengan`s home with Detective Takagi. He examines the sideboard where the trophies are displayed and realizes what has been bothering him. Later, Conan asks Takagi some questions and closes in on the truth behind the case...

episodes_data.title: The Kamaitachi Inn (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Kogoro, Heiji, and Kazuka visit an inn deep in the mountains of Nagano. Heiji acquires a photo of a figure carrying a scythe running across the surface of the outdoor bath. Conan and his friends have come to investigate the tru identity of this figure who resembles a kamaitachi. At the inn they encouter writers Nakama and Koyanagi who have come to gather information on the incident as well. While searching inside a dark storehouse, Heiji suffers a cut on his right arm, Kogoro suffers one on the back of his hand, and Koyanagi suffers one on her cheek. The kamaitachi crosses everyone`s mind. Additional incidents thought to be the work of the kamaitachi keep occuring...

episodes_data.title: The Kamaitachi Inn (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: As incidents thought to be the work of a demon known as the kamaitachi occur one after nother, Bonzo is murdered in the annex of the inn. Conan notices something odd about the crime scene, and based on the crime scene Heiiji believes the culprit came to the annex through the outdoor bath. However, the snow around the bath is undisturbed, meaning the culprit must have run across the surface of the outdoor bath. Nakama believes the kamaitachi must have done it after all. After hearing everyone`s testimony, Conan and Heiji close in on the truth behind the case and realize who the culprit is from a casual remark...

episodes_data.title: The Darkness of the Prefectural Police (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran visit the Kawanakajima battlefield while visiting Nagano where they run into Inspector Yamato and his associates of the Nagano Prefectural Police. Conan and his friends visit the Kansuke Shrine ruins and Yamamoto Kansuke`s grave, and while visiting the Chikumagawa River, their final destination, they come across a case: Inspector Takeda`s severed head came floating down the river. On the body`s forehead is a mark resembling a woodpecker`s footprint. Allegedly a mysterious group known as the Woodpecker Society exists in the Nagano Prefectural Police. Yamato and his associates search for someone who may have borne a grudge against Takeda and two cases in which Takeda shot and killed the suspects surface...

episodes_data.title: The Darkness of the Prefectural Police (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: After Nagano Prefectural Police Inspector Takeda is murdered, Lieutenant Kano is found dead from hanging in his home. From the body`s condition, Inspector Morofushi reasons that after being strangled, the body was hanged from the ceiling by someone. Later, the culprit sends an e-mail declaring that he will kill three additional people. Segreant Akiyama is called to Mt. Saijozan by the culprit and is dragged off a cliff by a car. Inspector Yamato`s fingerprints are found on the rope that was wrapped around Kano`s neck, and Section One Chief Kuroda puts out a BOlO for Yamato as the suspect who murdered three men...

episodes_data.title: The Darkness of the Prefectural Police (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: Inspector Takeda, Lieutenant Kano, and Sergeant Akiyama of the Nagano Prefectural Police are killed one after another. After observing the crime scenes, Section One Chief Kuroda puts out a BOLO for Inspector Yamato as the murderer of the three men. Conan learns about the man who holed up inside a bank six months prior and Kano`s maiden name from Inspector Morofushi and Detective Yui and closes in on the truth. He has realized who the Woodpocker Society is and the identity of the murderer. Meanwhile, Inspector Saegusa is called by Inspector Yamato to a shack on Mt. Saijo. Approaching from behind him in the culprit holding a stun gun.

episodes_data.title: The Shadow Approaching Amuro
episodes_data.description: In the morning, Conan notices a supicious man watching Amuro at the Poirot Cafe. On his way home from school, he spots the same man. Believing something must be up if Conan is interested in him, Mitsuhiko, Genta, and Ayumi follow the man. However, the man suddenly disappears when he enters a shopping area. Conan asks Amuro about the man, and Amuro confesses that he was followed three days ago when he went shopping. Conan warns Amuro that the man may be a member of the Black Organization...

episodes_data.title: The Actress Blogger's Locked Room Case (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan goes to a cake buffet with Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, Haibara, and Professor Agasa, where they meet Kitami Saya and Shono Kyona, two actresses competing for popularity on their blogs. Saya and Kyona have come to the hotel to film a drama set there. Kyona asks Saya if she`s seen her blogs and warns her that she should surrender if she doesn`t have to have her secret exposed. Conan checks Kyona`s blog but is unable to determine what the secret is. Later, Kyona is found murdered in her locked hotel room...

episodes_data.title: The Actress Blogger's Locked Room Case (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends meet Kitami Saya and Shono Kyona, two actresses competing for popularity on their blogs, at a hotel. Kyona, whose blog features Saya`s secret, is found murdered in her locked hotel room. Based on the conditions at the crime scene and Saya`s actions, Conan believes she is the murderer. Conan gets Saya`s story in room 504 and determines how she entered Kyona`s room and the murder weapon. Later, Conan checks Kyona`s blog again and discovers Saya`s secret. A conversation between his friends helps him realize the secret behind the locked room...

episodes_data.title: The Disappointing and Kind Alien
episodes_data.description: Unemployed man Hanzaki Yasuo is frightened when he sees office worker Takedera Hitoshi wearing a costume and slips and falls to his death at Beimyoji. Takedera has no malicious intentions, but because he caused an accidental death, it`s unlikely he`ll be cleared of charges. After questioning Takedera`s acquaintance first year student Kota and office workers Arisa and Susan who witnessed the incident, Conan and his friends suspect there may be more to the case. The Detective Boys investigate the case and close in on the truth, but later, a new incident occurs...

episodes_data.title: The Missing Fiancee
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is hired by Chokai, the son of the distinguished Chokai Conglomerate family, to find his missing fiance. Kogoro and Conan discover that she called her landlady to tell her she was moving and her boss to say she was quitting her job. As their investigation progresses, they decide to meet with an old woman named Shigemi, the last person to see Motoko. Kogoro determines that Shigemi killed Motoko to get her out of the way, but Conan feels as though the investigation is going a little too smoothly...

episodes_data.title: Kogoro's Pursuit of Rage (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is hired to be the bodyguard of popular idol Risa Purple, and Conan and Ran get to enjoy her concert. Just as the concert is about to begin, two masked men attempt to kidnap Risa. During the confusion, they mistake Ran, who is cosplaying as Risa, for the idol, and mistakenly kidnap her instead. Kogoro and Conan go after the kidnappers, but lose track of them during their pursuit. Kogoro borrows the truck of a recycling shop worker who saw the kindappers and Ran and continues his pursuit. Conan discovers the identities of the kidnappers from an objected dropped near the boat the kidnappers abandoned, but...

episodes_data.title: Kogoro's Pursuit of Rage (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Ran is mistaken for the popular idol Lisa and kidnapped. SNS messages between the kidnappers Takeyama and Ihara and Risa planning the kidnapping are found at their hideout. However, Conan believes the kidnapping to be the work of another kidnapper pretending to be Risa. Takeyama abandons the refrigerator Ran is trapped inside in the mountains. With the refrigerator sealed, the oxygen will eventually run out, and Ran won`t live to see the morning. Kogoro apppears on a local station and begs the kidnappers to at least spare his daughter`s life...

episodes_data.title: The Seven People in the Waiting Room
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran run into a typhoon on their way home from the hot springs and are forced to spend the night at the train station with salesman Hokari, factory manager Takegami, backpacker Carl, assemblyman`s secretary Norikoo, local old woman Fune, stationmaster Inagaki, and station employee Masako. When Kogoro exits the station`s hot spring, he discovers a scrap of paper in his coat pocket. On it is written the message “Mori-sensei, someone will be killed here tonight. Please catch the culprit. The culprit is--". Later, a murder actually does occur...

episodes_data.title: The Hidden Secret of Dongaraji Temple
episodes_data.description: Shishito dies in an accident two hours after stealing 30 million yen from Beika Finance. Before his accident, he hid the money somewhere. Kogoro is hired by Ryozen, head priest of Dongaraji Temple, to find the culprit who made the phone threat demanding that construction on the temple be halted. It becomes clear that brothers Toraya Kinta and Ginsuke became flustered when they saw construction had begun on the temple. Conan hears a strange story about Eisaku, the father of the brothers. Kogoro believes the Toraya family and the missing 30 million yen are connected and jumps to all kinds of conclusions, but...

episodes_data.title: The Suspects Are a Passionate Couple (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Big Osaka`s Higo Ryusuke and Okino Yoko`s passionate romance makes the news. Yoko fan Kogoro, Conan, and Higo fan Haibara decide to investigate if the news is true. Higo and Yoko were meeting at a restaurant run by Higo`s senior Asuka. The sommelier Yamada, waiter Konoe, and waitress Reiko search for Asuka who hasn`t yet returned but are unable to find him. Meanwhile, Hgio and Yoko discover Asuka`s body in the storeroom. Inspector Megure suspects Higo and Yoko who discovered the body, but...

episodes_data.title: The Suspects Are a Passionate Couple (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: When the body of Asuka, the restaurant`s owner, is found in the storeroom, Conan suspects the sommelier Yamada, the waiter Konoe, and the waitress Reiko. Inspector Megure`s suspicion towards Higo and Yoko, the first ones to discover the body, deepens. Conan notices something strange about the blanket Asuka was wearing while he slept. Recalling the restaurant staff`s testimony, Conan closes in on the truth and checks the lockers in the break room. Upon seeing Asuka`s clothes in the locker, he sees through the trick the culprit used to fabricate his alibi...

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys Get Out of the Rain
episodes_data.description: In the pouring rain, Conan and the Detective Boys stop by a mansion in the woods to borrow their bathroom. After speaking with the men "Bro" and "Skinny" at the mansion, he realizes they`re not the mansion`s residents, but robbers. While running from the two robbers armed with knives, the Detective Boys rescue Amamiya Maki, the bound resident of the mansion. Conan and his friends flee throughout the mansion with Maki, who doesn`t know where her husband is. Later, as Conan and his friends attempt to escape the mansion, they spot a pool of blood through an open doorway...

episodes_data.title: The Tidal Park Comeback Case
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran visit a park with a lake connect to the sea where the scenery changes according to the ebb and flow of the tide. When the tide flows out, Conan spots a body on the flood bridge. The body belongs to Kimishima Ryuji, the second president of a food manufacturing company. Marks on his neck indicate that he was strangled, and Kogoro investigates the case both as a murder and an accident. Park groundskeeper Tanba claims he didn`t see a body when the tide was out in the morning. Chiba prefectural police officer Motoi questions Ryuji`s wife Aoi and his brother Yuta. Both Aoi and Yuta seem to suspect each other...

episodes_data.title: The Beauty, the Lie, and the Secret
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran come across the scene of an accident. A man named Yaginuma fell to his death from the emergency staircase of a parking structure. On top of the stairs was Misaki, who claims to have been attacked by Yaginuma. She claims Yaginuma fell head first when she avoided his attack. One week earlier, Yaginuma broke into Misaki`s home and murdered her husband Takizawa Akira and stole 100 million yen worth of precious jewels from their safe. Kogoro believes Yanagi attacked Misaki to silence her, but after looking at Yaginuma`s body, Conan realizes there`s something wrong with Misaki`s testimony...

episodes_data.title: Ramen to Die For: 2 (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are taken to Sera`s regular ramen spot: the new location of "Ramen Ogura," where a murder previously occurred. Inside they find regulars Shono Yuna, Mizushina Sosuke, and Nakanishi Osamu eating. Conan finds the great quantities of condiments and seasoning they put in the food strange. After they leave, employee Sayo reveals a robbery murder occurred in the neighborhood a few days earlier. The police chased the culprit into the restaurant, and the customers present at the time were Shono, Mizushina, and Nakanishi...

episodes_data.title: Ramen to Die For: 2 (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: A week earlier, after murdering Tonda in the entryway oof her own home, her killer ran into "Ramen Ogura." The police have narrowed the suspects down to three regulars of the shop: Shono, Mizushina, and Nakanishi. After the incident, Yumi ran into her ex-boyfriend Haneda, who says he heard a strange noise every time the culprit took a step. Upon hearing Haneda`s story, Conan realizes something. He and Sera search the water tank of the store`s toilet, solve the mystery behind the reason the culprit was swinging a hose around after committing the crime, determine the reason they`ve continued to visit the shop, and close in on the truth...

episodes_data.title: The Mysterious Boy
episodes_data.description: When Conan and his friends hear that a UFO has been spotted at on the riverbed near Kometo Bridge, they go to observe the UFO. At the same time, Nagai, manager of Nagai Toys, brings debt collector Oshiro to Beika Bridge. From behind his back, Nagai throws a shining boomerang toy, and Oshiro leans across the bridge when he sees it. In the next moment, Nagai lifts Oshiro legs and drops him over the side. Later, Conan and his friends discover the boomerang toy and body, and Conan realizes the truth behind the UFO sighting...

episodes_data.title: A Cottage Surrounded by Zombies (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: When Kogoro, Conan, and Ran go to the cottage where a zombie movie was filmed, they encounter Heiji and Kazuha there. A couple ran over a zombie with a broken neck on a road near the cottage, and Heiji has come to confirm the truth behind the story. Later, a movie crew arrives to shoot a trailer for the sequel to the zombie movie. While filming, producer Harawaki goes missing, and the others search for him in the cottage. Conan and Heiji discover the body of the dead Harawaki, and...

episodes_data.title: A Cottage Surrounded by Zombies (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends discover the dead body of producer Harawaki at the filming location of a zombie movie. On his smartphone is a video of Harawaki drinking hydrocyanic acid. Because only the dead Harawaki was able to drive and there is no cell phone service at the cottage, they are unable to call the police. That night, the bedridden Kogoro tells Ran and Kazuha that zombies have surrounded the cottage. The girls don`t believe him, but they are immediately attacked by zombies. Conan and Heiji fight off the zombies, but...

episodes_data.title: A Cottage Surrounded by Zombies (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: After finding the body of Harawaki at the shooting location of a zombie movie, Kyoko is found dead next. On her smart phone is a video in which a zombified Harawaki bites Kyoko on the neck, and Harawaki`s body has disappeared from the other room. Conan and Heiji believe this case and the one from eight years ago may be related. Later, Gunma Police Inspector Yamamura begins his own investigation. With the help of eight year old photos and Kazuha`s comments, Conan and Heiji close in on the truth. Finally, they discover the trick behind the wardrobe and the identity of the killer...

episodes_data.title: The Great Detective's Weakness
episodes_data.description: Kogoro chases a robber armed with a gun to the roof of a building. The police eventually arrest the robber, but it soon becomes clear that the robber tossed the gun while fleeing. Kogoro, who already has a fear of heights, enters a state of shock after the fright of being shot at is compounded on top of it. Two days later, Sakaki, the leader of a futures trading group accused of fraud, is shot in the shoulder and leg by a person riding a motorcycle just after being released on bail. The gun used in the incident is none other than the one thrown away by the robber. Feeling responsible for the crime, Kogoro determines the identity of the individual who picked up the gun, but the case isn`t over yet...

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Died Twice (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro and Conan witness secretary Shinkai stabbing moneylender Takarada with a chef`s knife. However, Takarada had been strangled to death two hours earlier. Kogoro believes Shinkai stabbed Takarada without realizing he was already dead. Kogoro had been summoned to the apartment by Takarada to discuss a murder threat he received in the mail. Inspector Megure reasons that one of Takarada`s financial victims killed him for revenge, and Shinkai testifies that he stabbed Takarada to prevent said victim from becoming a murderer. Megure also suspects one of his family members may have committed the crime and questions his wife Mika and younger brother Koji, but...

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Died Twice (Part 2)
