episodes_data.description: Kogoro, COnan, and Ran are invited to dog food company president Anna`s birthday party and arrive at the yacht harbor. Shortly after the party begins, Anna is shot to death by a masked man wielding a shotgun. Inspector Megure questions vice president Inamura, director Machiko, and secretary Morishima, and Anna`s ex-boyfriend Hyodo emerges as a suspect. However, Hyodo has an alibi: he was robbing Anna`s apartment. Kogoro and the police suspect he fabricated his alibi, but...

episodes_data.title: The Poodle and the Shotgun (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran are invited to dog food company president Anna`s birthday party and arrive at the yacht harbor. Shortly after the party begins, Anna is shot to death by a masked man wielding a shotgun. Anna`s ex-boyfriend Hyodo emerges as a suspect, but because he has an alibi, the police are unable to arrest him. The next morning, Hyodo`s body is discovered alongside the shotgun that was used to kill him. Upon seeing the shotgun, vice president Inamura acknowledges that it belongs to him. Now that Hyodo has been murdered, the police believe someone else must be the true culprit, but Conan is certain Hyodo killed Anna...

episodes_data.title: Miss Lonely and the Detective Boys
episodes_data.description: While playing soccer in the park, Conan, Mitsuhiko, Genta, Ayumi, and Haibara meet Komori Tomoko drinking wine alone. With tears streaming down her face, she confesses that her beloved boyfriend has passed away. Later, Tomoko takes the children to a botanical garden, where they meet Kajiki Kohei, the president of a men`s cosmetics company. Tomoko and Kajiki hit it off, and the two begin dating. A few days later, Tomoko invites the children to her house to inform them of some exciting news. However, while ascending the stairs to the second-floor terrace, they hear a scream...

episodes_data.title: The Glamping Mystery
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko arrive at a luxurious glamping facility so they can enjoying camping in elegance and comfort. That night, while relaxing around the campfire, they hear a scream. Lying in the darkness is the body of Tosaki Keidai, with makeup on his face, a crab leg in his mouth, and a note in his hand. His wife Tosaki Kyoko, makeup artist Miura Mika, and chef Tanabe Hiroshi arrive on the scene and begin behaving suspiciously. When Conan asks them about it, they all admit to tampering with the body, but all of them deny killing Tosaki...

episodes_data.title: Mori Kogoro's Grand Lecture (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is asked to give a lecture to commemorate the renovation of HISHIDA Hall, and Kisaki Eri is scheduled to participate on a panel. The day of the event, panelists security company president Tsukinogi Hideki and actor Inokoshi Kenichiro come to greet Kogoro in his dressing room. Later, former manager Reizei and hotel owner Hishida Junko get into an argument. And 20 minutes before the lecture, Inokoshi is found murdered in his dressing room. Based on the conditions of the crime scene, Conan judges the case a locked room mystery...

episodes_data.title: Mori Kogoro's Grand Lecture (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Two murders occur at the event hall where Kogoro is scheduled to attend a speaking event. Kogoro accuses former hall manager Reizei of murdering actor Inokoshi Kenichiro, but he confesses to the murder of event hall owner Hishida Junko instead. The lecture is delayed an hour until Kogoro can determine the identity of the real culprit. However, everyone except for Reizei has an alibi for the time of the murder, leaving Megure and Kogoro without any suspects...

episodes_data.title: Mori Kogoro's Grand Lecture (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: Two murders occur at the event hall where Kogoro is scheduled to attend a speaking event. With the help of event staff Tsukuba Mei, the trick behind the locked room and time of the murder are exposed, and even evidence is found identifying security company president Tsukinogi as actor Inokoshi`s killer. She is asked to appear on the panel as the new generation`s detective, where she asks the great detective Mori Kogoro about a murder that happened at a certain college one year ago...

episodes_data.title: Kaiju Gomera VS Kamen Yaiba (Prologue)
episodes_data.description: Conan and friends come to Osaka when they are invited to the new building completion commemorative movie "Kaiju Gomera VS Kamen Yaiba" announcement event. During the announcement, the talented producer Yonekura is found accidentally crushed to death beneath a giant kaiju figure in a storage room. The rope supporting the figure was cut by a knife, and Osaka police inspector Otaki proceeds with his investigation of the incident as a murder rather than an accident. The suspects are narrowed down to Yonekura`s subordinate producers Kosugi, Mihara, and Kouchi, but...

episodes_data.title: Kaiju Gomera VS Kamen Yaiba (Interlude)
episodes_data.description: The talented producer Yonekura`s murderers Kouchi and Mihara steal Yonekura`s car and attempt to flee in it, but it immediately explodes. The driver of the car, Kouchi, dies instantly. Kyoto police inspector Ayanokoji is investigating a case in which scriptwriter Onda died when he drove his car off a cliff. Ayanokoji determines that Onda and Yonekura were once connected, and it also becomes clear that Yonekura was investigating Onda`s case. Later, another explosion occurs, claiming another victim, and the relationship between the cases begins to come into relief...

episodes_data.title: Kaiju Gomera VS Kamen Yaiba (Climax)
episodes_data.description: The fingerprints of Ishizawa, a former associate of Yonekura, Onda, and Suemura, are discovered on the bomb planted at the scene of Suemura`s murder. Inspectors Otaki and Ayanokoji believe him to be the suspect and head to his home, where they discover him with his hands bound, bleeding from the back of his head. Meanwhile, Keiji goes to Kyoto to investigate Onda, and Conan meets with Haibara, who has been examining the connection between Yonekura, Onda, and Suemura. 15 years earlier, all three were in debt, and all three paid off their debts 10 years ago...

episodes_data.title: Kaiju Gomera VS Kamen Yaiba (Finale)
episodes_data.description: Onda and Suemura were murdered by Yonekura over the robbery the four of them committed 10 years ago. Onda was blackmailing Yonekura, who then plotted to murder all of his former associates. Later, it becomes clear that there was a fifth robber. Conan and Heiji are certain Yonekura planted a fifth bomb somewhere in order to kill the last man. The police hurry to identify the fifth man, and Conan and Heiji go to the hospital to see Ishizawa. Later, they learn the identity of the fifth man, but they`re unable to find the final bomb planted by Yonekura...

episodes_data.title: The Young Kaga Lady's Mystery Tour (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan joins Ran and Kogoro on a trip to Kanazawa that Ran won in a lottery. While enjoying Kanzawa, they meet a woman named Mari who is behaving suspiciously. It turns out that she is a wealthy young lady disconnected from the real world. They decide to help Mari and later discover that she is involved in a criminal case. Furthermore, they all get caught up in the case as it moves in an unexpected direction...

episodes_data.title: The Young Kaga Lady's Mystery Tour (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran and Kogoro get caught up in a kidnapping case while visiting Kanazawa. However, it`s actually an act put on by the victim, former printed silk maker Saikawa Manabu. With the culprit identified, it`s only a matter of time before he is arrested, but then company president Hayashi Soichi is attacked. Based on his possible motive and witness testimony, Manabu seems like the most likely suspect, but...?!

episodes_data.title: Target: MPD Transportation Department (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Miike Naeko of the MPD Transportation Department is concerned about the lack of development in her romantic relationship with Detective Chiba and goes to karaoke with her colleagues Yagi Shiori and Momosaki Toko to sing away her sorrows. While there, Yagi and Momosaki learn that both of them have been followed by someone recently. Momosaki sends off the drunk Naeko and her caretaker Yagi. Once she`s alone, a suspicious man begins talking to her...

episodes_data.title: Target: MPD Transportation Department (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Miike Naeko of the MPD Transportation Department goes to karaoke with her colleagues Yagi Shiori and Momosaki Toko. On the way home, Momosaki is attacked once she`s alone, and her body is discovered the next day. One week earlier, Momosaki and Yagi arrested Aono Kengo, Akamine Manji, and Shiroyama Yuzo for traffic violations and got into a fierce argument, and the police believe it may be related to this case. Meanwhile Yagi goes to visit a certain individual...

episodes_data.title: Target: MPD Transportation Department (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: MPD Traffic Department members Momosaki Toko and Yagi Shiori are murdered one after another. Detective Sato and the rest of the police begin canvassing the neighborhood where Yagi fell. Miyamoto Yumi arrives on the scene and offers a certain tip... In order to acquire more hints, Yumi calls Miike Naeko, who went to karaoke with her colleagues the other day. All the while, a suspicious man listens in on her conversation with Naeko...

episodes_data.title: Target: MPD Transportation Department (Part 4)
episodes_data.description: With the help of Conan`s detective skills, the identity of the culprit who murdered MPD Transportation Department officers Momosaki Toko and Yagi Shiori is determined. Additionally, the police learn that one week earlier, the culprit heard the name "Yumi" while he was being disciplined for a traffic violation. Though the name referred to someone else, based on the victims` mutual acquaintances, it`s possible that Transporation Department officer Miyamoto Yumi may be his next target, and the search for the culprit begins. However, no one can get in touch with Yumi...

episodes_data.title: The Secret of the Search for His Wife
episodes_data.description: Near the train station, Conan and Ran encounter Higuchi Masaki, who is looking for his missing wife. Believing that something may have happened to her, Conand Kogoro begin questioning people in Higuchi`s neighborhood. Though they find few witnesses, the ones they do claim to have heard the couple arguing and screaming disturbing things at each other, such as, "Kill me tomorrow!"

episodes_data.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi
episodes_data.description: Kogoro and Conan are hired by a barmaid to find her missing pet "Armadillo-kun." The driver of the taxi they hire during their search turns out to be a huge fan of Kogoro and begins telling them about the suspicious brothers who rode in his taxi earlier...

episodes_data.title: The Broken Fishbowl
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is hired to serve as a bodyguard for the president of an investment company. When he and Conan go to check things out, they discover that his investments are a scam. As Kogoro turns down the job and begins heading home, someone discovers the body of the president, and...

episodes_data.title: The Case on the Opposite Shore
Leading a Detective Around by the Nose
episodes_data.description: A woman named Kanae asks Kogoro to find her stolen brooch. Kogoro and Kanae head to the park designated by the culprit, but once they arrive, they`re directed to a new location. Kogoro senses danger while they`re on the move and believes someone is trying to kill Kanae...

episodes_data.title: An Encouragement of the Perfect Crime
episodes_data.description: The police pay Kogoro a visit and begin telling him about a series of strange crimes that have been happening lately. Among the evidence for each crime was a "crime plot." Having determined the location of the criminal advisor, the police ask Kogoro to assist him as their own advisor...

episodes_data.title: Welcome to Bocchan Restaurant (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: While at a park, Conan and the Detective Boys discover a cat covered in injuries that was abused by someone. They decided to search for the culprit based off the blood and fibers left on the cat`s claws. Meanwhile, the head receptionist is found dead at Bocchan Restaurant. His shirt is strikingly similar to the fibers found in the cat`s claws...

episodes_data.title: Welcome to Bocchan Restaurant (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: The day Conan and the Detective Boys take an injured cat to the vet, head receptionist Uranari`s body is discovered at Bocchan Restaurant, which recreates the world of Natsume Soseki`s novel "Bocchan." As the police proceed with their investigation, possible suspect and manager Red Shirt is found dead the next day. The police believe he killed himself when he realized he couldn`t escape his guilt, but...

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Komei: The Targeted Lips (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Kogoro are joined by Heiji and Kazuha visiting from Osaka at the Suzuki Museum. Suzuki Jirokichi has challenged Kaito Kid to steal the world`s largest conch pearl on display at the museum known as the Fairy Lip, boasting that the gemstone can be seen clearly from all angles. Meanwhile, Kid has already disguised himself among the riot police but is reluctant to act in the presence of two high school detectives and the brilliant Inspector Takaaki. However, just then, a woman claiming to be the real owner of the conch pearl appears...

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Komei: The Targeted Lips (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Kogoro are joined by Heiji and Kazuha visiting from Osaka at the Suzuki Museum. Meanwhile, Kid has announced that he intends to steal the world`s largest conch pearl on display at the museum known as the Fairy Lip. He disguises himself as Kazuha and infiltrates the exhibition room. He seems to have successfully stolen the gemstone, but...?

episodes_data.title: The Two Faces (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A woman named Muto Masako comes to the Mori Detective Agency. She is looking for her missing husband. She spotted her husband in a neighborhood away from his workplace and tried to speak to him after he parted ways with an unknown woman, but for some reason he fled from her, and she lost sight of him. Conan and Kogoro find a business card at their home and go to visit the husband`s office, but...

episodes_data.title: The Company Dissolution Party
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro go to eat at a restaurant where they encounter the employees of online shopping site "Kureno" hosting a company dissolution party. When the company president is thanked for his work and handed a bouquet of flowers, he collapses. A poison needle was hidden inside the bouquet. The suspects are narrowed down to the party attendees, but...

episodes_data.title: The Feuding Girls
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko spot some models selling a toy seal that can be controlled using a smartphone at a shopping mall. While taking a break in the staff area, they see the same models. There appears to be animosity between them, especially between the two models who auditioned for the same commercial. Conan and the girls resume shopping and immediately hear a scream...

episodes_data.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary
episodes_data.description: While on their way to school, the Detective Boys help Ayumi decide what to write in her illustrated diary. Everyone offers their own advice, including Conan, who tells her she`ll find something to write about by closely observing her surroundings. Meanwhile, a small crowd has gathered around Jewelry Kaneko`s shop window to admire the luxury watch on display. Though it`s thoroughly protected by security systems, the drawings in Ayumi`s illustrated diary lead Conan to believe that a thief is attemping to steal the watch...

episodes_data.title: The Automatic Tragedy (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A man comes to the Mori Detective Agency to find his father`s killer. His father died after being struck on the head while at home, and 300 thousand yen in cash was stolen. The man explains that it`s his fault his father died...

episodes_data.title: The Automatic Tragedy (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While Oide Furuya was away from home, a burglar entered the house and killed his father Raita. Conan and Kogoro find the thief, but he insists that he didn`t kill anyone. Kogoro believes the suspicious woman they saw smirking at the Ode family near the train station may have drugged Raita. Meanwhile, Conan questions Furuya`s sister and mother about the day of the incident and notices something strange about the time of death...

episodes_data.title: Murder at the Townhouse Cafe
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko come to a townhouse café known for its photogenic donuts. However, inside the café are only the restaurant staff and a pair of suspicious customers. After spending some time at the café, a scream is suddenly heard from the bathroom. Inside is the manager, who was struck on the head and collapsed...

episodes_data.title: Kyogoku Makoto the Understudy (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: On their way home from watching a movie together, Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Kyogoku, and Sera come across a man armed with a gun who has taken a woman hostage. Thanks to Kyogoku`s efforts, the incident appears to be resolved... until he realizes that the man was an actor filming a TV drama. Kyogoku fills in for the actor he knocked unconscious. The rest of the group comes to the filming location to watch, and...

episodes_data.title: Kyogoku Makoto the Understudy (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Actor Tokuzono falls from the fourth floor of a school being used as a filming location. AD Odori figures out the culprit`s identity and sends them a message as he appears to be plotting something. The police begin their investigation around the unnatural placement of Tokuzono`s phone. Meanwhile, Sera asks Conan and his friends about Kudo Shinichi...

episodes_data.title: Kyogoku Makoto the Understudy (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: Actor Tokuzono falls at a drama`s filming location. AD Odori appears to have identified the culprit and is killed as well. Though he seems to have been poisoned, no poison is found in the drink he was holding up until his death. While Sera focuses on investigating Kudo Shinichi, Conan attempts to investigate the case, but...

episodes_data.title: The Skilled Hawk Hides His Crimes
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come to a traditional-style house cafe located in a mountain village. The cafe is currently holding its Okuho Mountain Village Festival, but only cafe managers and husband and wife Takehara Genichi and Takehara Satoko, falconer Akashiba Tetsu, and farmer Ishima Masahiko are present at the cafe. While enjoying the falconry and puffed rice making demonstrations, Conan and his friends spot Genichi, who had gone boar hunting, with a gunshot wound in his chest, and he dies right before their eyes...

episodes_data.title: Intrigue at Smile Village
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys are invited to high-class nursing home Smile Village, where residents Sakura, Sumire, Botan, and Azami are excitedly waiting for their arrival. Ever since the four ladies saw the Detective Boys on a trip, they have become their fans. However, something seems off about Chief Director Tango and Administration Manager Waltz...

episodes_data.title: The Frying Pan of Hatred
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come to test venture company Oshiro`s newly developed frying pan. Employees Taguchi and Tomi finish their presentation and call in President Omura to greet their guests, but he doesn`t show up. Conan and Kogoro run to the president`s office when they hear a scream, where they find Omura bleeding from the chest. Meanwhile, there is an explosion in the research wing of the office, and R&D Head Koshiro`s body is discovered...

episodes_data.title: Troublesome Kindness
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are eating at a restaurant where they overhear salaryman Kusano brag about all the "acts of kindness" he has performed. His colleague Yamanashi forces a smile as he listens, as it sounds to him like Kusano has been meddling instead of helping. Meanwhile, Kotani sits at the counter, trembling with rage. Kotani is a victim of Kusano`s meddling and is plotting something while watching Kusano...

episodes_data.title: The Moonlight Sonata Murder (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A letter from a client summons Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to Moonshade Island, a small island in Izu. However, the client is a pianist who allegedly died 12 years ago while playing the "Moonlight Sonata." In order to investigate their client, they head to the community center, where the previous mayor`s second anniversary memorial service is being held. During the service, the Moonlight Sonata begins to play...

episodes_data.title: The "Moonlight Sonata" Murder (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit Moonshade Island off the coast of Izu. The previous mayor`s second anniversary memorial service was held at the community center. During their stay, the Moonlight Sonata begins playing, and the current mayor is found dead. At the crime scene is a musical score written in blood, and Conan reads the message left behind by the killer...

episodes_data.title: The Beika City Shopping Center Garbage Bin Mystery
episodes_data.description: While cleaning the shopping center as a class activity, Conan and the Detective Boys find a heap of garbage. It seems that there was originally a garbage bin there. At the store association, an argument is taking place over the garbage produced by the increased number of eateries and other stores, as well as the installation of garbage bins. Why is garbage accumulating in the location of the now missing garbage bin...? Meanwhile, the rest of the world, including Teitan High School attended by Ran and her friends, is buzzing with excitement for the WSG, an international sports festival held once every four years.

episodes_data.title: The 36-Cell Perfect Game (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, Amuro, and Irohazushi chef Wakita take the Azusa limited express to Nagano. Originally, Sonoko was supposed to go with them, but she fell ill. Since Ran stayed behind to visit her friend, Amuro and Wakita took their places on the trip because the client Nichihara Taisei insisted in his letter to Kogoro that he bring a group of four. Included with the letter was a code written in katakana. The client`s request is, "My old friend hanged himself in an abandoned church deep in the mountains of Nagano, and I have no idea why. Please decipher the code and tell me the truth." In the chapel of the abandoned church they arrive at, they find five of Nichihara`s former high school classmates...

episodes_data.title: The 36-Cell Perfect Game (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, Amuro, and Irohazushi chef Wakita join their client Nichihara Taisei`s high school classmates for a total of nine people. They split up responsibilities and begin preparing to spend the night at the abandoned church, but office worker Wada is found dead in the toilet, shot in the forehead by a crossbow. They begin acting in pairs, and when Conan and Amuro are alone together, he asks him a question. At the same time, the sound of breaking glass rings through the church... Meanwhile, Nagano police inspector Morofushi sees Amuro in the video of the crime scene and recalls seeing hime somewhere before...

episodes_data.title: The 36-Cell Perfect Game (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, Amuro, and Irohazushi chef Wakita arrive at an abandoned church, where a series of murders occur. The group gathers around the four written codes that are the key to solving the mystery, but they struggle to decipher them. Just then, they receive a call from Nagano police inspector Yamato, who is clearing snow from the tunnel. He tells them that they will arrive in about three hours...

episodes_data.title: Who Poisoned the Victim?
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran are at a party hosted by Kogoro`s client, the second company president of Sasano Finance. The president was sent a death threat in the mail, and Kogoro has come to this party as his bodyguard. At the party are three guests, all of whom bear some grudge against the president. The threat is fulfilled and the president is poisoned. However...

episodes_data.title: Out for Revenge (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A body is found brutally murdered and stabbed numerous times. The police encounter Conan and Kogoro while investigating the victim`s acquaintances. When they learn his acquaintance is located in Beika City, they decide to help the police. They arrive at investment consultant Natsukawa`s office, where they also find finance business manager Fuyuki and real estate business manager Akiba. Though they should know who may have held a grudge against victim Haruyama, the three are uncooperative...

episodes_data.title: Out for Revenge (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: A body is found brutally murdered and stabbed numerous times, and the victim`s friend Natsukawa is killed by the same method. Komoto emerges as a suspect, the man they swindled using a made-up investment opportunity ten years ago. Komoto appears before Akiba, but he accidentally falls off a cliff. The serial murders seem to be over, but the next day, Akiba is found killed by the same method. Is Komoto still alive and continuing his revenge killings...?

episodes_data.title: The Lost Article That Smells Like a Case
episodes_data.description: Conan, Mitsuhiko, and Genta accompany Ayumi to the park where she found a bracelet. On the road facing the park are what appear to be tire marks from a vehicle that suddenly departed as well as bloodstains. In order to return the bracelet to its owner, the Detective Boys visit various accessory shops, which eventually leads them to a certain person, but...

episodes_data.title: The Idol Whose Smile Disappeared
episodes_data.description: Officer Yamasato Futoshi, who has been assigned to a police box in Beika City starting this month, comes to the Mori Detective Agency. There was a dine and dash at a Beika City restaurant, and a similar incident occurred in Haido City where he was previously stationed. It was allegedly a blonde woman in sunglasses who looked like idol group DDPP`s Kakurai Kayoko...

episodes_data.title: Picking Wild Plants and Clovers (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kobayashi-sensei, Wakasa-sensei, and the Detective Boys head to Gunma to check out the area before their class heads there for an outdoor lesson in nature. Former grade school teacher Zenda Maika is waiting for them at the train station. They get into her van and arrive at the location where they`ll be picking wild plants. They have a pleasant time at the nearby field, but...

episodes_data.title: Picking Wild Plants and Clovers (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys encounter a case while picking wild plants in the mountains. The body wasn`t in the photo they took by the car when the arrived, and the prime suspect, the victim`s own fiance Zenda Maika, has an alibi. The police discover a new suspect at the victim`s villa. Meanwhile, Conan finds the Clover Ayumi was looking for...

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Loved Too Much
episodes_data.description: While Conan and Kogoro are heading to the store to go grocery shopping, they find a crowd in front of a house they`re passing by. In the middle of a badly ransacked room is a man bleeding from the head. According to the couple that lives in the house, they happened to run into the man, who was a thief. They apparently killed him when he attacked them and they fought back. It seems like a clear case of self defense, but...

episodes_data.title: The Novelist Known as the Demon King
episodes_data.description: While walking through a residential neighborhood in Beika City, Conan and Kogoro come across a crowd of police and onlookers in front of a mansion. The mansion is the home of popular novelist Tawake Shintaro, who was found shot dead. Though there was a gun in the study where the murder took place, there are no witnesses. The body was discovered by his apprentices Akaike Naoya and Degawa Miyuki. He additionally had apprentices Bito Ryunosuke and Chigasaki Haruo for a total of four. While questioning the them, the police learn that Degawa`s apprentices wrote his books and they resented him...

episodes_data.title: Stakeout
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys follow Detective Chiba after they see him purchasing a large amount of food at the convenience store. He enters an ordinary apartment building. The kids wonder if he`s come to visit a friend, but Conan explains that the building is new and deduces that Detective Chiba must be conducting a stakeout here. They follow him inside, where they find Detective Takagi as well. The Detective Boys ask to stay until the professor can come pick them up and learn that the police are staking out this building because of the jewelry store robbery that occurred the previous week.

episodes_data.title: The Monorail Sniper Case (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: While riding a monorail to the bay coast, Conan and Kogoro witness another rider being shot and injured by a sniper. The monorail makes an emergency stop, and the two of them track down the culprit, eventually arriving at the apartment believed to be the shooting location. They don`t find the culprit there, but a forensics team determines that the shot was indeed fired from that room, which is also the scene of another murder. However, the bullet extracted from the victim at the hospital is a Tokarev cartridge not suitable for sniping...

episodes_data.title: The Monorail Sniper Case (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: A passenger on the monorail Conan and Kogoro are riding is shot and injured. Their pursuit of the culprit leads them to an apartment, but the culprit they discover there has fled to Toto Market. At the market they find a bound and gagged employee. The culprit stole the employee`s possessions and is up to something...

episodes_data.title: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan is invited to Agasa`s house, where learns that the professor is hoping to make a fortune selling an antique dish. Meanwhile, Haibara is anxious about Sera, who is keeping watch from in front of the house. Sera has come to check things out after being told by Ran and Sonoko that Haibara is mature for her age. Okiya shows up as well, and together they go to see the appraiser, but...

episodes_data.title: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Antique appraiser Nishitsu Hogen is stabbed to death with a spear. At the crime scene are securities company employee Tojima Motoyuki, former real estate company president Chono Kinji, and art museum director Sakamaki Suzue, all of whom came to have their black lacquer trays appraised. Professor Agasa recalls what happened when Nishitsu was still alive... Meanwhile, Sera is curious about one of Okiya`s behaviors.

episodes_data.title: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 3)
episodes_data.description: Appraiser Nishitsu Hogen is knocked to the ground and then stabbed to death with a spear. The police look for someone who can appraise the black lacquer trays at the crime scene but have trouble finding someone. While searching the house, the police find a box containing the dish Professor Agasa sought to have appraised. According to the housekeepers, Nishitsu said he was looking forward to seeing the surprised faces of the clients he had coming that day...

episodes_data.title: Rondo in Bad Company
episodes_data.description: A man is found bludgeoned to death at a small park in Beika City. When Conan and Kogoro pass by, they learn that the victim Mitsumoto was a scoundrel with a bad reputation and was apparently killed the previous night around 7PM. Around that same time, Hosaka, Mitsumoto`s troublemaker friend, was seen running from the park...

episodes_data.title: The Cursed Museum
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the Ancient Oriental Culture Museum. The objects on display are replicas at this handmade museum. Ran and Sonoko are apparently here for the Egyptian god keychains that are currently popular among high school girls. Conan looks for a way to pass the time while they`re engrossed in keychains...

episodes_data.title: The Whistling Bookstore 3
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys are attending author Omura Kosuke`s writing class. They were introduced to him by their acquaintance Tamaki Book Cafe employee Yoshikawa Michiko. The owner of the house where the class is behind held and Omura`s sponsor book collector Nojima Ryoji and his housekeeper Takeuchi Nagisa arrive. Nojima flies into a rage after reading Genta`s novel, and...

episodes_data.title: Ooka Momiji's Challenge (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Ran receives a message from Ooka Momiji. It is a request for Kudo Shinichi to solve a code. A housekeeper who worked for many years at the mansion of a wealthy man passed away, leaving her four sons a code. She loved mysteries and sent each brother a different code so they would have to work together in order to find the treasure. Immediately after the brothers shared their codes with each other, they lost contact with the eldest brother. Fearing he may have encountered trouble, they put out a request for the code to be solved and find their missing brother. Momiji is coming to Kyoto on this day in order to fill them in on the details, but...

episodes_data.title: Ooka Momiji's Challenge (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: At Ooka Momiji`s request, Conan and Heiji solve the code left to four sons by their mother who worked for a wealthy family for many years. They arrive at Haido Harbor Warehouse 4, where they find a man on the ground bleeding from the head and three others standing around him. They are the brothers who received the code from their mother, and the dead man is the eldest brother. They were invited to the warehouse by the eldest brother, but he was already dead by the time the first brother arrived, and the other two met up with him after that. Based on the metal frame glasses on the ground nearby, Conan and Heiji believe this was a murder...

episodes_data.title: The Wordless Witness
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come across the police investigating a crime scene. The body of a woman who was bludgeoned to death in the street the previous night was discovered. Two similar incidents occured the previous week, and the police believe all three crimes were committed by the same culprit. Because they were drunk, the victims could not recall anything about the attacks, and there are no security cameras in the area. While wandering around the crime scene, Conan spots a house. Someone is observing the crime scene from the second story...

episodes_data.title: Beyond the Curtain
episodes_data.description: Professor Agasa, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi are eating at a third-story restaurant in the city. While looking outside from their table, through the curtains in the window, they see the silhouettes of a man and woman enjoying a party in the apartment building across from them. However, the scene shifts, and the man appears to attack the woman. The hurry to call the police, but...

episodes_data.title: Ballad of the Woman Who Loved Cake
episodes_data.description: After chatting in front of the ruined building where Western Confections Paradise plans to build its new factory, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi discover a right hand emerging from some concrete debris. The three of them faint, and when Conan discovers them and hears what happened to them, he finds a trail of blood leading elsewhere. They believe the person whose hand they saw is alive and must have gone somewhere. They follow the trail to the Western Confections Paradise store, where they recall having a conversation a week earlier. The beautiful woman they saw then is sitting in the same seat eating the same cake now...

episodes_data.title: Police Academy Arc: Wild Police Story - Case. Matsuda Jinpei
episodes_data.description: It`s nIghttime at the Metropolitan Police Academy. As the cherry blossoms fall, the sounds of Furuya Rei and Matsuda Jinpei duking it out echo across the premises. Even though they`re attending a police academy, Matsuda dislikes Furuya`s determination to become a police officer no matter what. Neither one gives any ground as their fight continues. Around 2AM, Morofushi Hiromitsu wakes from a nightmare and hears a knock on his door. Standing outside his room is Furuya, who is covered in injuries. Upon seeing him, Morofushi asks Furuya if he thinks he`ll get along with the guy who did that to him. During their morning assembly, standing next to the injured Furuya and Matsuda are their classmates Morofushi Hiromitsu, Hagiwara Kenji, and Date Wataru. Rookie class instructor Onizuka Hachizo asks how they got their injuries, but Date thinks quickly and tells him a lie. Furuya finds it odd when Matsuda demonstrates a thorough understanding of a police officer`s responsibilities despite his hatred of the police and begins investigating his past.

episodes_data.title: The Blank Year (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: While walking through a residential neighborhood in Koneru after finishing a job, Kogoro hears a scream. He follows the scream and finds a man named Esaka Ritsuo sitting on the ground. Apparently someone pushed his back while he was waiting for the signal to change and was nearly hit by a car. At the detective agency, Conan and Kogoro listen to Esaka`s story. He has lost his memories from the past year and believes he may have done something to incur someone`s enmity during that time...

episodes_data.title: The Blank Year (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro conduct an investigation in Koneru in order to find the lost memories of Esaka Ritsuo, who lived in the area for the past year. In Koneru, he`s reunited with the people he spent time with, and he nearly regains his memories when he`s barked at by a dog. Two days later, Conan and Kogoro head to Esaka`s home with high hopes, where they learn he`s been found dead.

episodes_data.title: Mori Ran, the Model
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran are at the studio of Kasuga Ryuji the artist. Kasuga approached Ran in front of a department store while she was out shopping, and she has been working part time as his model. Kasuga`s assistant Rokui Riko and his apprentice Komiyama Yoshio are at the studio as well. When Conan sees something shining unnaturally outside the window, he goes into the yard to investigate, where he learns something from the gardener...

episodes_data.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (Opening Move)
episodes_data.description: While the Detective Boys excitedly discuss soccer on the way home from school, Conan is thinking about a different news story. Missing professional shogi player Nishikido, who was suspected of matching fixing, was murdered and found dead. At the crime scene was a shogi board with one leg cut off. The kids are discussing the origin of the term "yaocho" (match fixing) featured in the article Conan was reading when Haneda Shukichi shows up. Shukichi explains that he played against Nishikido and describes his impression of the man. The Detective Boys notice Shukichi is neatly dressed and believe he`s going on a date with his girlfriend Yumi, but Shukichi denies it, saying he`s meeting someone important instead, and leaves. Soon afterwards, Yumi shows up following Shukichi, as she finds his behavior suspicious. Claiming he`s less likely to notice she`s following him if she has a child with her, Yumi drags Conan off with her. Conan and Yumi follow Shukichi and witness him buying a bunch of donuts and having a friendly conversation with a couple of women...

episodes_data.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (Brilliant Move)
episodes_data.description: At the apartment where Shukichi attends shogi study sessions, one of its members Genda Yasukiyo is murdered. The home of former study group member Kishida Yuhei catches fire, and his body is found inside. Meanwhile, Shukichi appears to have noticed something related to the identity of the culprit and is kidnapped. Conan meets up with Akai, and together they go to rescue Shukichi.

episodes_data.title: Taiko Meijin's Shogi Board (Checkmate)
episodes_data.description: At the apartment where Shukichi attends shogi study sessions, Genda Yasukiyo, one of the group`s members, is murdered. The home of former study group member Kishimoto Yuhei catches fire, and his body is found inside. Meanwhile, Shukichi seems to have noticed a clue to the culprit`s identity and is kidnapped. Conan meets up with Akai, and together they go to rescue Shukichi.

episodes_data.title: Whiteout (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Professor Agasa brings Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta to a snowy mountain in the winter to go skiing. On their way to the ski resort, they meet drug manufacturing company president Ishibashi Kengo and doctor Yokoyama Takeru when they discover their car stuck in the snow and help them get unstuck. Apparently they are on their way to go sport hunting. They part ways after exchanging contact information, but a suspicious car follows along after them...

episodes_data.title: Whiteout (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Ayumi witnesses medicine manufacturing company president Ishibashi Kengo murdering Dr. Yokoyama Takeru at a ski resort. Ishibashi realizes what happened, and he attempts to chase down Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta. As they are fleeing from him, they end up off the ski trail and must walk through the snow, where they encounter two of Ishibashi`s goons waiting for them. Though they use their sled to escape their pursuers, the goons meet up with Ishibashi and resume their search for the Detective Boys. The kids end up at a cabin. As Conan is using his phone in an attempt to make contact with the outside world, he manages to get in touch with Professor Agasa, but...

episodes_data.title: Police Academy Arc: Wild Police Story - Case. Date Wataru
episodes_data.description: Furuya and Date fight one another during their arresting techniques class. When Date wins, he asks Furuya why he didn`t go after his weak point and that he must be stronger than anyone else if he wants to carry out justice. That night, Furuya contemplates Date`s words while lying in bed alone. Morofushi arrives at Furuya`s room to inform him he`s going out. Furuya says he doesn`t need anything when Morofushi asks but remembers shortly afterwards that he`s out of toothpaste. He exits his room to ask Morofushi, Hagiwara, and Matsuda to pick some up, but they`re already gone, so Furuya heads to the convenience store alone. He finds Date outside, who tells him about a past incident with his father...

episodes_data.title: The Flying Jack-o'-lantern
episodes_data.description: Conan arrives at Cafe Poirot because Ran and Kogoro are going out, where he finds store employee Azusa making jack-o`-lanterns for Halloween. While helping her, Conan learns everyone is talking about the recent discovery of some jack-o`-lantern ghosts. Just then, three men and women hurry into the store, claiming their pumpkins have been stolen...

episodes_data.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 2
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta go out for a drive in Professor Agasa`s car. On their way home, they pass a building with an unnaturally flickering light in a third-story office. Deciphering the Morse code for SOS, they head to the office, where they find a tied up motorcycle deliveryman. He claims a bomb has been planted in the room, and the hurriedly flee the scene.

episodes_data.title: The Unstated Alibi
episodes_data.description: An old woman is pushed down the stone steps of a temple in Beika City. She claims she was pushed by a young woman, but there is no other information about the case. In the crowd is a man staring at the old woman. The police speak with him, but he suspiciously claims he doesn`t know anything about the incident and leaves. He seems to have witnessed what happened, but for some reason he can`t speak about it...

episodes_data.title: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Hagiwara Kenji
episodes_data.description: Hagiwara, Furuya, Date, and Morofushi spot an RX-7FD3S at the police academy. It`s apparently Hagiwara`s favorite model, and he overwhelms Instructor Onizuka with an impassioned speech when the instructor exits the car. However, the car belongs not to Onizuka but a senior cop who died on duty. The deceased cop`s daughter wants to become a police officer, and Onizuka is holding onto the car until then. Later, during heavy equipment training, they discuss Hagiwara`s earlier behavior. Hagiwara knows a lot about cars because his family ran an auto repair shop. However, his family`s shop was forced to close, and he explains that he`s trying to become a police officer because the police force will never go bankrupt. After training, a man approaches Hagiwara and Matsuda...

episodes_data.title: The Figure of Revenge
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys arrive at the apartment of Mitsuhiko`s acquaintance. He creates figures with the members of his university club and has agreed to show his club`s figures to the kids. The kids are shown around the studio, but one of the club members is unhappy about it from start to finish. His mood is apparently related to the contest to which they`re planning to submit the figure they`re currently working on...

episodes_data.title: The Deadly Pork Soup Signal
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro see a patrol car parked in front of the apartment building they happen to pass by. Inside the building, a woman who lives alone was found dead. Three sets of fingerprints were found at the crime scene. The first set belongs to the man she was dating, and the second set belongs to the owner of the bar she worked at. The police have no record of the final set. Since there are no signs of forced entry, the police believe she was killed by an acquaintance.

episodes_data.title: The Birthday Party of Divine Punishment (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Sonoko, and Sera are invited to their classmate Sekizawa Yumi`s birthday party. Because her older sister Sekizawa Remi the model`s birthday is one day earlier, their joint birthday party is attended by numerous celebrities, Remi`s manager Kushiyama Mitomu, Remi`s classmate and pastry chef Hatsune Tsuguo, and hair and makeup artist Hanasaki Mizutoshi. Conan, who has trouble speaking due to the cold sore he developed several days earlier, takes out a pill case so he can take some medicine before the party starts when he`s spotted by Sera. Inside the case is the APTX-4869 antidote Haibara gave him during his school trip...

episodes_data.title: The Birthday Party of Divine Punishment (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Sonoko, and Sera attend the birthday party of their classmate Sekizawa Yumi and her older sister and model Sekizawa Remi. During the party, while the restaurant lights have been turned off for a slideshow, hair and makeup artist Hanasaki Mizutoshi, who had been hitting on the Sekizawa sisters, can be heard groaning in pain. When the lights come on, Hanasaki`s dead body is on the floor. Furthermore, the words "divine punishment" have been written on his forehead... Meanwhile, Sera recalls the day her mother Mary was turned into a child.

episodes_data.title: The Red Sheep's Eerie Game (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A man arrives at the Mori Detective Agency claiming his girlfriend has been kidnapped by a red sheep. The man received a threatening message, but for some reason, there was no demand for a ransom. Upon seeing the sheep, Conan and Ran feel like they once saw the same sheep a long time ago. Kogoro and the client head to the park at night, but... Meanwhile, curious about the red sheep, Conan and Ran head to the park as well.

episodes_data.title: The Red Sheep's Eerie Game (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While Kogoro is investigating the false kidnapping of the Red Sheep game meant to test a boyfriend`s courage and love, Conan and Ran run into someone wearing a red sheep costume in the street at night. After the red sheep departs, they find the body of restaurant La Mucho owner and head cook Wakabayashi Tetsusaburo. Because the restaurant is also the workplace of Takigawa Ami, who set up the false kidnapping, and her boyfriend Beppu Ryota, they believe the incidents are related and visit the restaurant. While asking about alibis, they learn that since several weeks ago, videos featuring a red sheep pranking couples and running away have been getting a lot of attention on a video sharing site. Meanwhile, the police searching Wakabayashi`s home discover a threatening message on his computer...

episodes_data.title: The Threat to Megure's Police Career
episodes_data.description: The body of a man is discovered at an abandoned construction site within the metropolitan area. Brought to the scene by an anonymous call, judging by the condition of the body, the police believe the murder took place elsewhere. Meanwhile, unable to get in touch with the man`s family, a local police officer is sent to the victim`s home. The safe within the ransacked home has been left open, and an ornament with blood and hair stuck to it is found on the floor. After examining the scene, the police determine the crime took place here and begin their investigation. Two days later, the police identify a man who persistently hounded the victim. Inspector Megure is shocked when he hears his name. It is a man with a grudge against him due to something that happened three years earlier. Inspector Megure risks his own career to arrest him, but...

episodes_data.title: Intrigue at Morikawa Mansion (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran accompany Kogoro to the mansion of a client, soft-serve ice cream maker Morikawa Yuzan. Yuzan has cancer and not long left to live, and asks Kogoro to advise him on distributing his legacy. At the mansion are his heirs and sons Moriakwa Yuichiro, Morikawa Yujiro, and Morikawa Yuzaburo, as well as Oi Hiroki the lawyer and Shito Yuka the chief butler. The brothers won`t stop talking about the inheritance, and each one is desperate to get his hands on their father`s legacy...

episodes_data.title: Intrigue at Morikawa Mansion (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran accompany Kogoro to the mansion of a client, soft-serve ice cream maker Morikawa Yuzan. Yuzan has cancer and not long left to live and asks Kogoro to evaluate his three potential heirs. His third son Morikawa Yuzaburo is found dead inside a locked room. Furthermore, his second son Morikawa Yujiro, who had been missing since the previous day, is found dead inside the soft serve tank. His eldest son Morikawa Yuichiro breaks down, saying he`s next, and locks himself inside his room.

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys' Test of Courage
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys are hanging out at Professor Agasa`s house watching "Softie Sadao and Scaredy-cat Toshiko Visit Haunted Locations" paranormal videos on a streaming site. Conan and Haibara accompany the other three to an abandoned hospital so they can film their own ghost video at a haunted location. They begin filming as they head towards the locked room on the third floor said to be inhabited by a ghost. Apparently there are a variety of spooky rumors regarding this location...

episodes_data.title: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, Genta, and Haibara are on the bus with Kobayashi-sensei and Wakasa-sensei to Hatoyama Ranch to collect the new chickens they`ll be caring for at school. Also on the bus are Hitsuka Junya, Nanbu Takashi, and Kano Shogo, who are headed to the same ranch. They are apparently going there to gather information and conduct research. There`s trouble on the bus, but Amuro saves the day. Amuro seems to have business at the ranch as well...

episodes_data.title: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and his companions head to a ranch to pick up some chickens for their grade school and get dragged into a dangerous situation. A man claiming to be the ranch owner`s younger brother takes Ayumi hostage and locks Conan, Amuro, Mitsuhiko, and Kobayashi in the basement beneath the office. There they find the body of the ranch owner and Kazami Yuya. Conan successfully gets in touch with Haibara and the others above ground, but... What are the objectives of the three men visiting the ranch and the owner`s younger brother?

episodes_data.title: The Ghost's Revenge
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro meet a manager of an accounting firm at the hospital who`s been told he has six months left to live. Also with him are his wife and secretary, and it seems as though he plans to make the most of his remaining time. However, several days later, he`s found murdered in his home. That morning, his wife and secretary went out to run an errand at his request. When they returned that evening, they found him dead in the bathroom. Just then, the man`s friend comes running in.

episodes_data.title: I Want My Husband Back
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro see a news story on TV about the disappearance of traffic accident victim Butsumaru Daijiro. Mori Fusae, the woman who witnessed the accident, handed over Butsumaru`s driver`s license to the police, but Inukai Hajime, the man who caused the accident, vanished after saying he would take Butsumaru to the hospital. Meanwhile, the Mori Detective Agency receives a phone call from Butsumaru`s wife Emiko, who hires Kogoro to find her husband and bring him back safe...

episodes_data.title: Bad Guys
episodes_data.description: Conan hears two women scream while on the way to the park with Genta and Mitsuhiko. They go to the house where they heard the screams, where they see Hirasawa Kaori and Hirasawa Seiko, who have fallen down some stairs. From their conversation with Hirasawa Ryoji, who arrives shortly afterwards, they learn the women are his wife and mother-in-law, and he is the family`s son-in-law. It seems as though all they do is cause trouble for Ryoji. Later, Conan and his friends see Ryoji struggling near the park. According to Ayumi, her neighbors have been talking about the Hirasawa family...

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Camped Out at the Police Station
episodes_data.description: Kogoro spots Inspector Megure walking in front of Cafe Poirot. He congratulates the police on recently solving a case in record time, but apparently they arrested the wrong man. Conan meets up with them and Inspector Megure explains the case to them. A man was found dead in his home. At the crime scene were a rope and metal pipe, and the police believe the culprit entered by opening a hole in a glass window, knocked the victim unconscious with the metal pipe, and then strangled him to death. The victim`s girlfriend`s testimony pointed to her ex-boyfriend as a possible suspect, but...

episodes_data.title: Okino Yoko and the Locked Attic (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Okino Yoko comes to the Mori Detective Agency to ask him to solve a murder that happened at a villa. Several days earlier, Yoko headed to a villa where a Nichiuri TV producer`s sister went missing after she got married to scout the location. His sister`s husband and brother- and sister-in-law were there as well. But the night they decided to stay at the villa... Just as he was preparing to explain his deduction, Kogoro shuts himself inside the bathroom instead. Wakita Kanenori from Iroha Sushi shows up at the office, and then--?!

episodes_data.title: Okino Yoko and the Locked Attic (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Okino Yoko comes to the detective agency, and Wakita Kanenori and Conan end up having to solve the case she describes that happened at a certain villa. The people present at the villa during the case had all kinds of relationships with the woman who went missing two years ago, giving all of them possible motives for killing the murder victim in the case. While attempting to solve the case based on things Yoko found strange, Conan receives a message from Kogoro, who is in the bathroom...?

episodes_data.title: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story Case. Morofushi Hiromitsu
episodes_data.description: While Instructor Onizuka is reprimanding his police cadets, Morofushi spots the missing person report for a young girl who went missing the previous night. His friends ask him why he`s so interested in the girl, but simply explains that she looks similar to a girl he used to play with as a child and refuses to elaborate. With coaxing from his friends, Morofushi eventually opens up and begins telling them about the murders he witnessed as a child...

episodes_data.title: The Spiral of Rain and Malice
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys discover an abandoned car by the river. Though they`re interested in the car, they quickly head off to play because rain is forecasted for that evening. While playing soccer, Genta nearly runs into a nearby woman. She was speaking into a voice recorder, but their near collision leads to her playing soccer with the kids. After a while, they begin hearing thunder, so they leave behind the woman who seems to be waiting for someone. The next morning, Conan sees a certain story on the news...

episodes_data.title: The Targeted Chicken Sexer
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro arrive at a chicken egg factory. Kogoro is asked to investigate what`s causing the strange things that have been happening to chicken sexer Nanba over the past few weeks and act as his bodyguard. They question the factory employees, but nobody can think of anyone who would want to harm him. However, one of his colleagues seems to have reservations about him. Furthermore, they learn about a chicken sexing legend from the reporter who has come to the factory to gather information. Later, when they attend Nanba`s lecture, they witness an attack on him...

episodes_data.title: The Dreamy-Eyed Woman's Last Shot at Love
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko have come to the newest date spot. When they discover the elderly Kamogawa Haru anxiously sitting on a bench, they go to speak to her believing she may be lost. Just then, a man appears. Conan and his friends assume he is Haru`s son based on his appearance, but he is apparently her boyfriend Kazama Joji. Noticing that Haru is fairly wealthy, Sonoko believes Kazama, who is young enough to be Haru`s son, is a gold-digger and cautions her against the relationship, but the couple blows her off...

episodes_data.title: Detectives Don't Sleep
episodes_data.description: A woman named Nishiwaki Kae arrives at the Mori Detective Agency where Conan and Kogoro are. She explains that someone has been breaking into her apartment while she`s at work and asks Kogoro for help. The intruder, who began breaking in a month ago, apparently is not a thief, but leaves gifts for her. The three of them head to her apartment and discover a suitcase with a ribbon on it in the entryway. Believing it is a new gift from the intruder, Kogoro opens the suitcase and finds a dead body packed inside...

episodes_data.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro are attending a wedding. Kogoro met the groom`s father at a bar where he`s a regular and ended up receiving an invitation. Also attending the wedding are staff including the wedding planner and priest, as well as the couple`s friends. The ceremony begins, and just as the bride enters the chapel, she begins choking and loses consciousness. Upon seeing her pain, the people in attendance say ominous things such as "she got what she deserved" and "this wedding was cursed."

episodes_data.title: The Shopping Center in Love
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro pass by a dreary shopping center. They attempt to purchase some things at a vegetable shop, but the owner, Yamazaki, seems listless. Just then, Madam Gaga, a producer who revitalizes run down shopping centers, and her assistant Rabbit Suzuki show up. Madam Gaga announces that a pro wrestling event will be held to revitalize the shopping center. The shop owners engage in various forms of exercise to train, and Kogoro agrees to participate in the event as a referee, but...

episodes_data.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes
episodes_data.description: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko arrive at a takeout pizza restaurant. They participate in the store`s campaign to guess the weight of a ball of pizza dough, and thanks to Genta, they win a free pizza. After splitting the pizza into fifths and placing their slices inside special boxes, they head home. On their way, all of them have their pizza stolen by someone. When the kids meet back up, each one has a torn pizza box. Conan and Mitsuhiko realize based on the damage that the culprit was after their boxes.

episodes_data.title: The Sweet Voice Heard Through the Phone
episodes_data.description: The Mori Detective Agency receives a phone call from client Nagamine Mayako. Mayako has an appointment at the agency office, but she seems to have gotten lost. Though it`s past her scheduled appointment time, Kogoro, who knows from her social media photos that Mayako is beautiful, seems excited. The client noticed her husband has been acting suspiciously and would like him to investigate the possibility that he is involved in criminal activity. Kogoro continues waiting for a while, but Mayako never shows up, and the agency receives another phone call...

episodes_data.title: The Surprise That Leads to Tragedy
episodes_data.description: While on their way home from visiting Professor Agasa`s friend`s apartment, Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta hear a scream. They rush to the scene, where they discover a man bleeding from the head as well as a woman. The woman who lives at the apartment noticed something off about the place when she came home and grabbed the golf club she kept for self-defense. The lights wouldn`t turn on, and as she entered the apartment, she heard a loud noise... The police confirm her story and believe it was an unfortunate accident. However, certain elements of the case catch Conan`s attention...

episodes_data.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Yusaku is approached by a TV reporter when he exits the Metropolitan Police Department. He`s asked if he visited the police to confirm that the false charges against Kaito Kid had been dropped. However, Yusaku responds that his assistance was requested with the series of locked room murders that recently took place. He announces that he has solved the cases and will reveal the solution on a live broadcast over the weekend and even leaves a message for Kid before he departs. However, Yusaku runs into trouble on the day of the broadcast!

episodes_data.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Three victims who seem to share nothing in common are discovered within locked rooms in the serial locked room murder case. Yusaku`s advice was requested by the Metropolitan Police Department, and he was scheduled to solve the case on live TV, but he ends up sick in bed with food poisoning. Yukiko, who was going to disguise herself as him and appear in his place, gets sick as well. Conan hears the doorbell ring and goes to open the door to the Kudo family home to turn down the TV appearance but comes face to face with Yusaku, who should be sick in bed...?! Kudo Yusaku`s unrehearsed and unprepared detective show begins!

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys' Pursuit of the Purse-snatcher
episodes_data.description: Ayumi runs into a purse-snatcher and the man pursuing them, Kume Shosaku. The other Detective Boys arrive, and while they`re being filled in, a body is discovered in the apartment complex the culprit fled into. Next to the body are the jacket the culprit was wearing and the bag they stole. However, the money is missing from inside the bag, and the dead man doesn`t look like the culprit. Meanwhile, Inspector Megure receives a call that the body of a man who has Kume`s wallet and 300,000 yen has been discovered.

episodes_data.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Mojiko & Kura Part)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are invited to visit Shimonoseki by the lawyer Oi, who they previously met during the inheritance dispute case. The clients are the fourth generation owner Izumiya Makoto and his daughter Kaede, who run the long-established fugu restaurant Izumiya. A thief entered their house while the restaurant was busiest and no one was home and stole their family`s treasured cooking pot. While the pot is valuable, to the family, its true worth is in the broth that`s seeped into the pot since the restaurant`s founding. Conan and his companions question the four suspects identified by Oi`s investigation, but...

episodes_data.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Shimonoseki Part)
episodes_data.description: The lawyer Oi sends Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are sent to Izumiya, a long-established fugu restaurant in Shimonoseki, and are hired to find the family`s stolen treasured cooking pot. During their investigation, Kogoro comes into contact with a suspicious person in the city at night. Once he`s alone, they tell him to mind his own business and attack him. Is his attacker one of the four suspects they questioned during their investigation? Conan visits their restaurants to speak with them again and taste the dishes they pride themselves on.

episodes_data.title: The Charismatic CEO's Secret Plan
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro discover a body in a busy downtown area. The victim died instantly when he was struck on the head with a metal pipe, and there`s a dying message in the street. They visit the victim`s apartment, where the property manager tells them he said he`d pay all the rent he owed as early as the next day. The Utagawa Corporation CEO enters the picture when the manager describes how the victim reacted to the magazine he was reading the day of the murder, introducing the possibility that the victim was killed for attempting to blackmail the CEO...

episodes_data.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Hunt)
episodes_data.description: For several days, pairs of unidentified foreigners have been turning up dead. While discussing the case on their way home from school, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara come across a foreigner who has fallen off a building. When Conan sees Vodka on the roof, he instructs Haibara to take the three kids and leave the scene. Conan discovers an FBI ID and phone displaying a coded message on the fallen foreigner and heads to the Kudo family home, where he finds a gathering of FBI agents.

episodes_data.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Landing)
episodes_data.description: For several days, the Black Organization has been killing FBI agents. Conan and the FBI deduce that the Organization must be deciphering the FBI`s coded messages, so they decide to use it against them by laying a trap for them. Supposedly dead Camel and Mark, the older brother of a killed agent, are chosen to go to the meeting location. However, no one arrives at the location indicated by the code, and shots are fired on the agents keeping watch. Will Camel be able to evade the Black Organization without them realizing he`s still alive?!

episodes_data.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Identity)
episodes_data.description: Cornered by the Black Organization the FBI were trying to trap, Camel drives his car into the ocean. He manages to escape to Umizaru Island, where he warms up at the campsite. However, his location is given away when they spot his fire. The Black Organization arrives on the island in order to kill Camel and get a look at his face. In order to evade them, Camel acquires coffee bean bags and straws from the cafe on the island as instructed by Akai, but... How will the Black Organization`s battle against the FBI over Agent Camel end?!

episodes_data.title: The Cameras Targeting Haibara
episodes_data.description: Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko invite Conan and Haibara to the Beika department store. They have their sights set on the department store lottery`s grand prize, a Hachijo-jima whale watching tour. The professor asks Haibara to withdraw some cash for him, so she heads to the bank`s ATM. However, Kogoro arrived just before her, and his card has been swallowed by the machine. On their way to another branch, they spot a suspicious man in a black coat. He appears shocked when he sees Haibara, and then...

episodes_data.title: My Beloved Dog Pan-kun Is a Good Boy
episodes_data.description: While playing at the park, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara hear a dog barking loudly and a woman screaming. They head to the location of the sound, where they find housewife Yamada Sachiko and her beloved dog Pan being attacked by a man wearing a ski mask. Rather than rescuing his owner, Pan flees during the commotion. With help from Conan and the kids, Sachiko escapes danger. Sachiko, who doesn`t know why she was attacked, heads home with Pan once he returns, but Conan and the kids are curious about the masked man`s goals and decide to investigate.

episodes_data.title: The Alley of Sad Betrayal
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro are enjoying a meal at an Italian bar in an alley while chatting with the owner Yamaura when the wall is suddenly demolished. The culprit is Kusumi, the owner of the alley, who has been harassing shop owners who refuse to vacate the alley. One shop owner even died from the stress. Sushi restaurant owner Fumio and creative cuisine restaurant owner Yonezawa arrive when they hear the commotion, and with their help, they successfully run off Kusumi. But when Kogoro visits the bathroom a while later, he discovers someone inside...

episodes_data.title: Behind the Scenes of the J League Finals
episodes_data.description: Kawasaki Frontale takes on FC Tokyo in the J League 30th anniversary match. Conan and the Detective Boys have fun participating in the special event. However, once the event ends and they return to their seats, for some reason Haibara is in a bad mood. She wanted to enter the pitch holding hands with her favorite player Higo of Big Osaka, but she showed up on the wrong day. Haibara expresses her disappointment over her team`s loss and Sanada`s poor play... only to realize Sanada is standing right next to her! While watching the match together, Haibara notices something odd in the stands.

episodes_data.title: The Freezing Cold Men
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro encounter some men arguing at the hospital. They are Ryoichi and Reiji, the sons of Kenzo, president of Aizawa foods, and senior executive director Bando. Kenzo, who is inside the treatment room, is the cause of their argument. The three men begin telling Kogoro about the circumstances when Kenzo collapsed in the refrigerated warehouse when the doctor finishes treating Kenzo. Kenzo, who is now awake, tells the others that he simply fell asleep from exhaustion. However, Conan senses there is something off about Kenzo`s words and behavior.

episodes_data.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kazuha is visiting Tokyo, and Conan and Ran join her on a trip to Haido Shrine, which is said to provide matchmaking benefits. Because today is a lucky day, the shrine grounds are crowded with people. Ran, who wasn`t aware the shrine was a popular spot, asks Kazuha how she learned about it. She apparently learned about the shrine through Heiji when she happened to see him looking it up on his phone. Based on his recent behavior, Conan realizes Heiji must be here as well and goes after the suspicious man wearing a fox man he spots. Meanwhile, Kazuha notices someone in the crowd who doesn`t seem interested in matchmaking...

episodes_data.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan and Ran are invited to Haido Shrine by Kazuha, where they meet Heiji wearing a fox mask. The four of them get caught up in the murder that takes place there. The victim is Hidaka, an investigative police officer, who was looking at flashcards of mugshots of wanted criminals. Believing Hidaka was pursuing wanted criminals at the shrine, Conan and Heiji contact Detective Takagi, who finds three wanted criminals among the shrine visitors. Each criminal has a reason for remaining at the shrine and seems to have been aware of Hidaka`s presence...

episodes_data.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 3
episodes_data.description: While on their way to go shopping, Conan and the Detective Boys hear a man scream. They head towards the sound, which brings them to a tanning salon. Inside the building is salon employee Tsunoda Yasuo, who informs them that there is a dead body in the third room from the back. They head down the dark hallway and find the body of Nishitani Shin inside a tanning machine. He is a bodybuilder with tanning gel rubbed all over his body in order to achieve an even tan. The police arrive, and according to their investigation, the gel was poisoned...

episodes_data.title: The Unfortunate and Suspicious Victim
episodes_data.description: While passing by Doterasu Shrine in Beika City, the Detective Boys hear a scream and rush to the scene. They find Jupita on the ground, who struck his head after falling down the stone steps. Jupita is taken to the hospital and is likely to survive.  Jupita`s older sister and rising songwriter Juria and her mentor Saimon meet the Detective Boys at the hospital. Just before being attacked by a mugger, Jupita called Juria to tell her he was in another town. The Detective Boys begin investigating why Jupita lied about coming to Beika City.

episodes_data.title: The Genius Restaurant
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys arrive at a candy shop that`s just reopened. A band is playing, and the kids are given plums to celebrate the grand opening. Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta are fascinated by their first traditional candy, but Conan doesn`t seem interested. Genta calls Conan arrogant for acting all grown up. The two get into an argument, and Conan leaves alone. On his way home, an old man jumps out of an alleyway, declares he`s seen an omurice corpse, and requests Conan`s help...!

episodes_data.title: The Culprit Who Disappeared into the Sleeping Town
episodes_data.description: While walking down a deserted road after completing a job, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro hear the sound of an alarm whistle and a scream. The sound leads them to security guard Nezu Goro, who has been stabbed in the stomach with a knife. Nezu points towards the main avenue and says the words "white clothes" before he dies. Furthermore, at the top of the stairs Nezu is thought to have fallen down is the crying and screaming Yuki Keiko and the body of her husband Yuki Hideto, the IT company president. Conan heads towards the main avenue in pursuit of the culprit where he encounters a young man dressed in black.

episodes_data.title: Girls Day Mystery
episodes_data.description: Even as the band rushes around to get ready, the day of their first live performance is upon them. None of them feel ready, but before they know it, it`s time to go on. As Tomori stands on the stage, her legs trembling, the crowd grows restless.

episodes_data.title: Stakeout 2
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys discover Detectives Takagi and Chiba on a stakeout. Believing the children will leave once they realize there`s nothing for them to do, they begin explaining the robbery that occurred that morning. The culprit has been identified as unemployed man Fujiki Kazuma, but he hasn`t returned home. The police`s investigation turned up Fujiki`s ex-girlfriend, who he is likely to turn to for help if he`s on the run. Though the children are told the culprit has been identified and there`s no mystery to solve, something catches Conan`s attention...

episodes_data.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko visit Teitan Elementary School to take care of the rabbits. The man they encounter there sees Haibara and asks if she`s Miyano Akemi`s younger sister Shiho. His question frightens Haibara, but he is Teitan Elementary School graduate Murata Sho. His former classmates Yanagimachi Gaku and Ichihashi Seiko join him, and Conan and the Detective Boys learn Akemi attended Teitan Elementary School. The graduates planned to dig up the time capsule they buried when they graduated, but only Akemi knew where it was buried...

episodes_data.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While taking care of the rabbits at the animal shed, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko meet Teitan Elementary School graduates Murata Sho, Yanagimachi Gaku, and Ichihashi Seiko. They`ve been asked to dig up a time capsule while the rest of their class prepares for the class reunion. Akemi, the only person who knows the location of the buried time capsule, left behind a code, and the Detective Boys work with the graduates to find clues. But something strange happens during the search, and Conan believes someone may be interfering with their search for the time capsule.

episodes_data.title: The Missing Man's Dream
episodes_data.description: Nakajima Takako visits the Mori Detective Agency and explains that her husband is missing. She lost contact with him three days ago, and the police aren`t taking her concerns seriously. Conan and Kogoro begin examining the husband`s personal effects they received from Takako. Among his belongings are photos from their honeymoon, of her husband diving with his coworker and a ship`s captain, and her husband posing with his younger brother in front of their parents` home. They find nothing remarkable on the husband`s computer, so they visit his workplace, but...

episodes_data.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 2
episodes_data.description: As Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara finish helping park warden Kimishima Satoshi, he asks them to find the owner of a lost baseball cap. They follow the clues to the home of Katsumi Nozomu, where they find a police officer patrolling the neighborhood and warning Katsumi about burglaries. When the Detective Boys hear his warning, they decide to investigate the burglaries themselves.

episodes_data.title: Did I Do It?
episodes_data.description: Sako Manabu, a man with bloody clothes, arrives at the Mori Detective Agency. After a series of unfortunate events, yesterday Sako went out to drown his sorrows, but he can`t remember what happened. When he woke up, his glasses were broken and his clothes were covered with blood. He only had a bump on his head, so he realized the blood belonged to someone else.
