Concerned that he might have done something terrible, he sought help. Though they initially believe there are no clues, Conan finds hints on Sako`s body...

episodes_data.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Ran, Kogoro, and Sonoko arrive at a popular restaurant. Conan and Professor Agasa join them inside after showing up late, where they are greeted by Nanjo, president of Suzuki Security, in disguise. He has been receiving threats since he provoked the thieves who stole a safe the other day, and is feeling constrained by the bodyguards assigned to him. Later, Nanjo steps away to visit the restroom. Conan realizes the professor has been in the restroom for a long time, and when he goes to check on him...!

episodes_data.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, Kogoro, Sonoko, and the professor visit a popular restaurant. The professor runs into Nanjo, who asks to swap places with him, and he is mistakenly kidnapped by a couple who were planning to kidnap Nanjo. While pursuing the culprits, Conan is rescued by Kanagawa police officer Hagiwara Chihaya. They pursue the yellow getaway vehicle on Chihaya`s motorbike, but the detective badge they had been relying on is disposed of. The professor still has in his possession a listening device, and they use the sound heard through it alone to continue their pursuit...

episodes_data.title: The Troublesome 20 Million Yen
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran visit the home of client Nemoto Eriko. Three months ago, Eriko lost her husband Nemoto Yutaka in a traffic accident. While going through his things, she found 20 million yen in the back of the closet. Believing it could be dirty money, Eriko hired Kogoro to determine where the money came from. Kogoro considers the possibilities of savings or lottery winnings but eventually begins investigating armed robberies that took place recently. They narrow down the list of possible cases and visit the victims.

episodes_data.title: Pride of the Immortal Man
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro discover the body of Tsukuba Corporation president Tsukuba. He died after falling from the roof of a building, and a mysterious message was inside his pocket. When they visit his office to gather information, the employees respond to the message`s words "third time`s the charm". Tsukuba was attacked twice over the span of several days. Just as the police decide to investigate the death as a successful attack by the culprit, Tsukuba`s aunt shows up and says she received a call suggesting it might be a suicide. The police begin investigating the death as both a murder and suicide, but...

episodes_data.title: The Akabeko and the Three Lucky Men
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the exhibition of up-and-coming artist Bekobe Motoko. Motoko has attracted international attention with her avant-garde works that combine the traditional akabeko with modern art. While viewing the exhibition, they hear a scream. They rush to the source, where they find Motoko strangled to death. In the body`s left hand is an akabeko, and her right hand is pointing at a dying message that says "fuku"...

episodes_data.title: The Teen Novel That Smells Like Guilt
The True Culprit Is on the Run
episodes_data.description: While playing in the park, Conan and the Detective Boys find a man`s body in the bushes. According to the police, the man is Takamatsu Jiro, who worked in a nearby building as a moneylender, leading them to believe the murder may have been an armed robbery or related to money troubles. The blood on the rock used to kill him suggests the culprit is covered in blood. The children, who were in the park the whole time, didn`t see anyone suspicious, and the trail of bloody footprints they find ends abruptly.

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit. The highlight of the exhibition is a tiara set with the world`s largest garnet passed down from queen to queen known as the Queen`s Bang. Because Kaito Kid has declared his intent to steal the tiara, a long line has formed at the exhibition. They find Amuro and Azusa in line, and they decide to wait in line together. While waiting, at Azusa`s suggestion, Amuro performs a magic trick to kill time, but...

episodes_data.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: The Queen`s Bang tiara, centerpiece of the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit, is stolen by Kaito Kid! The exhibition hall is suddenly enveloped in white smoke, and by the time it has cleared, the tiara inside the case has vanished. Because a gas mask would ruin his disguise, it`s unlikely Kaito Kid was wearing one. The suspects are narrowed down to Amuro, Azusa, and Kazami, who were standing near the tiara without masks, so Conan decides to investigate.

episodes_data.title: I Was Set Up!
episodes_data.description: Conan and Kogoro visit the home of real estate company manager Sanada on a job. However, Sanada says he no longer needs his help and offers him a cancellation fee. Sanada`s eagerness for them to leave leads Kogoro to question him, and Sanada begins explaining that he never intended to kill anyone. Three days earlier, Sanada`s real estate office was visited by a man named Inumaru. Blackmailed over wrongdoings he never committed, Sanada asked his friend Kawakatsu for advice, but then something happened.

episodes_data.title: The Secret Hidden by the Cards
episodes_data.description: Mitsuhiko and Genta enjoy playing a trading card game against each other at a table set up in a used bookstore. Conan, Ayumi, Haibara, and Professor Agasa are with them. TCG tournament regulars Nitta, Masaki, Zaizen, and Kuno show up. As usual, Zaizen heads to the bathroom before the game. He instructs Kuno to watch his valuable rare cards, so Nitta as well as Conan and his friends move away from the table. Suddenly, the store enters a state of chaos...

episodes_data.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara visit Professor Agasa while he`s sick in the hospital. On their way home, they happen upon Detective Takagi chasing down a robber. Detective Sato arrives from another direction to execute a pincer move on the robber, who is successfully apprehended. When Detective Takagi opens his police notebook to note the time of arrest, he notices the code written there by Detective Date, who passed away in a traffic accident one year ago. Thinking he may be able to decipher it, Conan reviews the code, which leads them to...

episodes_data.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Haibara, and Detectives Takagi and Sato decipher the code Detective Date left in his notebook and arrive at café Poirot. They deduce the ransom handoff method described by the kidnapper based on information left at Poirot and successfully rescue Alan, the son of the vice president of a French car maker. The case seems resolved until they learn Alan was being held captive along with his friend Inukai Yuji. They must deduce the location where he is being held based on Alan`s time in the car.

episodes_data.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A job brings Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to a resort area in Gunma Prefecture, where they run into Inspector Yamamura investigating a case. Inoue Kohei was murdered by Rube Goldberg Machine, a device made up of a chain reaction of many simple gimmicks.

episodes_data.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: When the contraption that was used to kill the victim is found, the falling chimney incident at the resort area Conan, Ran, and Kogoro were visiting is investigated as a homicide. Several of the victim`s acquaintances are staying nearby, so they go to question them. The victim`s wife, the company`s president and CEO, an old friend and shareholder, an investor with whom the victim had a rocky relationship, and the victim`s mistress are all suspects. They discover one of the suspects is rather knowledgeable about the type of device found at the villa and becomes the prime suspect, but...

episodes_data.title: Last Dinner for You
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come across an Italian restaurant on fire. A nearby man rushes inside the building. In an attempt to stop him, Kogoro follows him inside, where he discovers a body. The police investigation identifies the victim as Head Chef Marcello. The man who rushed into the building was Akiyama the waiter. Later, the owner Kurasaka, his daughter Mariko, and the victim`s wife Arisa arrive. The police believe a burglar broke into the closed restaurant and ran into the victim while he was cooking, but...

episodes_data.title: The Holed-Up Sensation
episodes_data.description: A man armed with a gun shows up in a residential neighborhood. He takes a woman hostage and holes up inside a nearby home. Conan and Kogoro rush to the scene after seeing the situation on TV. The police are confused by the culprit`s nonsensical demands. The homeowner arrives and tells the police not to worry about breaking down doors or walls since the home is vacant and will be demolished the next day. While they`re talking outside, two gunshots are heard from inside the house...

episodes_data.title: Karate Teacher Mori Ran
episodes_data.description: Ran steps in as a temporary karate instructor when the dojo`s regular instructor is injured. Just as the class is ending, a scream is heard from the second floor.

episodes_data.title: Girls Day Mystery 2
episodes_data.description: While the boys relax at a hot spring, the girls happen to meet up at a snowy mountain resort. They are enjoying their day together, when they discover that strange pranks have been happening at the resort.

episodes_data.title: The Four-Person Class Reunion
episodes_data.description: Detective Kogoro is asked to be the bodyguard of the owner of a high-end host club. On the first day of his duties, he finds the owner dead in his own pool. It looks like one of the members of his annual four-person class reunion may be responsible.

episodes_data.title: Mystery of the Lost Treasure
episodes_data.description: Conan accompanies Sonoko to the studio of a famous potter. While there, Conan discovers that one of his pottery pieces has been broken, and worse, that the piece was already sold! It will take Conan`s skills in deductive reasoning to figure out the culprit.

episodes_data.title: The Dangerous Melon Field
episodes_data.description: Detective Kogoro is asked to investigate the damages and theft of a melon farmer`s crops. While at the farm, there are several mysteries they will have to solve...

episodes_data.title: Stakeout 3
episodes_data.description: The kids assist Detective Takagi in trying to catch a murderer. They have to stakeout a bakery to try to find the culprit. Can they focus on solving the crime instead of focusing on pastries and sweets from the bakery?

episodes_data.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Detective Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in Gunma after solving a missing persons case when Detective Mori calls Detective Yamamura. Detective Yamamura asks Detective Mori for help with a murder that took place directly on the border between Gunma and Nagano.

episodes_data.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Detective Yamamura`s past holds a key to solve the mystery of the murder on the border between Gunma and Nagano. With the best detectives on the scene, can they solve this murder mystery? Did the victim leave any clues behind?

episodes_data.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 4
episodes_data.description: Ayumi is tired of so many peaceful days in a row and enlists the help of the Detective Boys to hunt for a case. Unfortunately, when one goes looking for trouble, that is exactly what they usually find...

episodes_data.title: The Detective Who Lost His Mind
episodes_data.description: Detective Kogoro is called upon by a beautiful client. Fortunately, Ran sends Conan with her father, since she knows he has a penchant for being blinded by pretty women...

episodes_data.title: Interrogation Room 2
episodes_data.description: A former grade school teacher confesses to committing a murder, but the more the police question him, the more questionable his testimony sounds.

episodes_data.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: While at a bookstore, Conan stumbles upon a note from a child named Kazuo who`s been kidnapped. Conan is able to switch places with Kazuo, but will he be able to outwit the kidnappers and escape himself?

episodes_data.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan helps the married couple that kidnapped Kazuo, doing his best to make sure that their child, Tetsuya, is safely reunited with them. But what fate lays in wait for Kazuo?

episodes_data.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys are having lunch and talking about their favorite band, when they spot Kobayashi-sensei, Det. Chiba and Shukichi Haneda. Ayumi assumes they are on a triple date, but...

episodes_data.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: A poisoning occurs at the restaurant where Conan and the Detective Boys are dining, but without knowing how to plant the poison, the investigation grinds to a halt. Detective Kobayashi looks to Conan for advice…

episodes_data.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 3
episodes_data.description: At the venue for the "North American Flower Festival: Audition for the Role of the Lord," Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta encounter Makio Yuita and Kōzō Yuita, who are arguing. After Makio leaves, the remaining Kōzō explains that the two of them are brothers who happened to meet at the audition venue.

episodes_data.title: Best Husband
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit the home of politician Reiko Mutsu. They are guided by her secretary, Shinji Inui, and wait inside the mansion, but Reiko doesn`t appear for some time. Suddenly, Reiko`s scream echoes through the mansion.

episodes_data.title: Misfortune of the Positive Man
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys become acquainted with a kind man named Shojichi Aida. While heading to Aida’s apartment, they encounter a quarrel between his neighbor, Nenji Kotakara, and the landlord, Teruyo Imaizumi.

episodes_data.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: A stage play modeled after Kogoro and Heiji is being planned, and Conan and the others have come to Kyoto for a meeting. When they visit the director`s home, they find the producer, stage manager, and scriptwriter there.

episodes_data.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Conan, Kogoro, and Heiji are at the home of the director, Kabumoto, for a meeting about a stage play. Present are also Momiji Ooka, who claims to be Heiji`s fiancée, and Hyoe Kuroda, an officer from the Metropolitan Police Department.

episodes_data.title: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys are distressed to discover the flavor of popular ramen shop Ogataken`s flavor has changed, so they head to the restaurant to investigate.

episodes_data.title: The Moving Police Box
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys help with the unveiling of a mobile police box car. While the vehicle is touring around, it is hijacked by some robbers, and everyone onboard is taken hostage.

episodes_data.title: The Sister Troubled by Her Naughty Brother
episodes_data.description: Shigatsu Makabe comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request after malicious flyers began being posted on his own apartment condominium. Kogoro, who was conducting surveillance at the condominium, apprehends a suspicious young man, but... A few days later, a body is found in a unit of a luxury condominium.

episodes_data.title: Girls Day Mystery 3
episodes_data.description: The Five Detective Girls come together yet again to solve a case while having a girls` day out, but this time, as ninjas.

episodes_data.title: The Mori Family House Sits
episodes_data.description: Kogoro receives a request from literary critic Takahiko Kamiyu: "I am planning to go to the countryside, so I would like you to stay home and watch over my house for three days."

episodes_data.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan and the Detective Boys visit the Edogawa Rampo Residence under the guidance of Ms. Kobayashi. Professor Goto, who manages the residence, learns about the Detective Boys and offers to guide them through the storehouse, which is not usually open to the public.

episodes_data.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: While Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting the Edogawa Ranpo Residence with Kobayashi-sensei, a series of murders occur. Conan realizes the case isn`t over yet and rushes to solve the crime before another victim can be killed, but the culprit is already closing in on their next target.

episodes_data.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Conan visits Sera`s hotel room at the Haido Hotel, lured in by the code used in the hotel serial bombing case. However, they realize the hotel they`re at is the bomber`s next target when they happen to be present when the next bomb threat is discovered.

episodes_data.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: With help from Haido Hotel`s lawyer Kisaki Eri, Conan and Sera get their hands on the previous hotel bomber codes and narrow down the room with the bomb to six rooms. With the time limit approaching, will Conan and Sera be able to identify the culprit?

episodes_data.title: The Whistling Bookstore 4
episodes_data.description: While reading at Tamaki Book Cafe, the Detective Boys meet Komachi Ami, who accidentally sold a precious book that was a keepsake from her father.

episodes_data.title: Stakeout 4
episodes_data.description: While visiting an amusement park that`s shutting down after 50 years, the Detective Boys run into Detectives Takagi and Chiba dressed as security guards. A jewelry store robber hid stolen goods in the park six years earlier, and their accomplice is coming to retrieve them before the park is torn down.

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Wakasa-sensei and Okiya Subaru chaperone Conan and the Detective Boys to a beach in Shizuoka that is running a collab with Kamen Yaiba. After enjoying the beach hut`s collab menu, the kids play in the water while the adults sit on the beach... when suddenly, a murder is discovered at the beach hut!

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Wakasa-sensei and Okiya chaperone Conan and the Detective Boys to a beach in Shizuoka that is running a collab with Kamen Yaiba, where they get involved in a murder case. Three beach hut employees are suspected of killing their manager Usui. Koriyama is under most scrutiny, as he was found sleeping next to the body, but Conan senses something is off about his unnatural fatigue.

episodes_data.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kaito Kid declares his intent to steal the Siren Splash, a crown embedded with one of the world`s largest tourmalines. However, Suzuki Jirokichi is confident in his newest anti-Kid device, the Fujin Road. As the clock counts down to Kid`s arrival, will Conan the Kid Killer once against be able to stop the Reiwa Wizard?

episodes_data.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Kid makes the Siren Splash crown vanish from its display case at the Suzuki building, but the alarm was never triggered. Just how did he do it?

episodes_data.title: Last Dance
episodes_data.description: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are invited to a dance party. While changing into their dance shoes, a scream is heard.

episodes_data.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran visit Yakushima in Kagoshima Prefecture to investigate the case of a body being abandoned on Jomon cedar.

episodes_data.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is certain the culprit is Tsukada, but Conan and Ran aren`t so sure.

episodes_data.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 2
episodes_data.description: A woman is robbed at a shrine`s jewel-washing festival.

episodes_data.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (Part 1)
episodes_data.description: Kogoro is hired to investigate a theft at a charity concert that took place three years ago.

episodes_data.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (Part 2)
episodes_data.description: The video evidence suggests that the band`s guitarist stole the donations from the charity concert, but Conan suspects another member.

episodes_data.title: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House
episodes_data.description: A couple discovers a body inside the walls of their new home.

episodes_data.title: The Whereabouts of the Goodbye
episodes_data.description: Kogoro`s client is found dead in her apartment. The police suspect suicide, but Conan isn`t so sure.

episodes_data.title: When the Shishiodoshi Sounds
episodes_data.description: Conan investigates Komada murder; a photo captures the killer’s strike but hides his face. Who is the culprit?

episodes_data.title: The Secret's Afterimage
episodes_data.description: Megure suspects his subordinate of having an affair.

episodes_data.title: Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5
episodes_data.description: The Detective Boys film a documentary about Kogoro and the serial vandalism case he solved.

episodes_data.title: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark
episodes_data.description: When a valuable old coin is found at an inn, a man is murdered and the coin goes missing.

episodes_data.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Bloody Knight
episodes_data.description: Conan and his friends attend a chess tournament to show support for Inspector Shiratori.

episodes_data.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Perceptive Devil
